### Create `apps/api/test/integration/transparency-head.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { HEAD_KINDS, HEAD_RULES, HEAD_WITNESSES, PublicFacts, PublicHead } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { createApp } from "../../src/app";
import { createAuth } from "../../src/auth";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { loadConfig, type Config } from "../../src/config";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { createTransparency, witnessFrom, type SketchStore } from "../../src/transparency";
import { headValue } from "../../src/transparency/head";
import { TEST_TOKEN } from "../../src/transparency/witness";
import { fakeWitness, grantedAnswer } from "../transparency/fake-witness";
import { pgError, rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

/**
 * The audit head's daily value on the database (3d design, sections 2 row 9, 6.5, 7.7, 7.14 and 10.6; Task 5; 12.1 rows
 * 22 and 24, 11.1's row "A published head is changed"): head_value() against the API's own digest; head_publications'
 * closed lists, grants and two triggers as the API's role, which can publish no value of its own making and set the
 * token and the publication each once; the transparency job's day: the row, the witness (off, test and rfc3161 against
 * fakeWitness()), the publication, the keeper's mail through the auth module's mailKeeper, head_unwitnessed and
 * head_missed; and GET /api/public/head, which never holds the place. The job's clock stands in January 2027, so its
 * daily edition pass asks for 2026's edition, which is not due on the database's clock, and writes nothing; the head's
 * day is the database's own today. Every row the test commits is deleted afterwards, as the migrator.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the audit head's daily value (3d Task 5)", () => {
  let config: Config;
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });
  const KEEPER = "keeper@korbat.example";
  /** No sketch exists: the job's month close finds nothing to close. */
  const noSketches = { exists: async () => 0 } as unknown as SketchStore;
  /** The job's clock: a January morning of 2027 after the dispatch hour, one day further for each new day's pass. */
  let day = 0;
  const clock = () => new Date(Date.UTC(2027, 0, 4 + day, config.MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR, 30));

  const cleanUp = async () => {
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.head_publications`);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind in ('head_unwitnessed', 'head_missed')`);
  };
  /** The database's today and the audit head as they stand. */
  const today = async () => (await migrateDb.execute<{ day: string }>(sql`select to_char((now() at time zone 'UTC')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as day`))[0]!.day;
  const auditHead = async (q: Pick<DbTx, "execute"> = migrateDb) => (await q.execute<{ seq: number; hash: string }>(sql`select seq::int as seq, hash from public.audit_head where id = 1`))[0]!;
  const dayBefore = (d: string, n: number) => new Date(Date.parse(`${d}T00:00:00.000Z`) - n * 86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  /** The module as index.ts builds it: the auth module's mailKeeper over a memory mailer, and the witness the settings name. */
  function build(overrides: Partial<Config> = {}, witness?: ReturnType<typeof witnessFrom>) {
    const settings = { ...config, ...overrides };
    const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
    const auth = createAuth({ config: settings, logger, authDb, kv: new MemoryKv(), mailer, profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb), turnstile: { verify: async () => true }, breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false } });
    const module = createTransparency({ apiDb, redis: noSketches, auth: auth.forTransparency, config: settings, logger, now: clock, ...(witness ? { witness } : {}) });
    const app = createApp({ config: settings, logger, rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(), healthChecks: {}, auth, transparency: module });
    return { module, app, mailer, kept: () => mailer.sent.filter((m) => m.template === "head_published") };
  }
  const headRows = () =>
    migrateDb.execute<{ day: string; kind: string; chain_seq: number | null; value: string; witness: string; token: Buffer | null; published: boolean; retired: boolean }>(sql`
      select to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as day, kind, chain_seq::int as chain_seq, value, witness, token, published_at is not null as published, retired_at is not null as retired
        from public.head_publications order by day desc, kind`);
  const alerts = () => migrateDb.execute<{ kind: string; facts: Record<string, unknown> }>(sql`select kind, facts from public.alert_outbox where kind in ('head_unwitnessed', 'head_missed') order by id`);

  beforeAll(async () => {
    config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 2 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 1 });
    await cleanUp();
  });
  afterEach(async () => {
    await cleanUp();
    day++;
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await cleanUp();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  test("head_value() is the API's digest of the tag, the day, the place and the hash; its lists are HEAD_KINDS and HEAD_WITNESSES; the grants are 6.5's", async () => {
    const [vectors] = await apiDb.execute<{ lab: string; empty: string }>(sql`
      select public.head_value('2026-10-18'::date, 42, '24cc975360df565521f1acca5b67f924d33ca0a0999355f667c4c289b1632fe1') as lab,
             public.head_value('2026-10-19'::date, 0, ${"0".repeat(64)}) as empty`);
    expect(vectors!.lab).toBe("917907fc36f065a78e0b730230eac9c4f1c2882c77efc7a868a65ee336e0899e");
    expect(vectors!.empty).toBe(headValue("2026-10-19", 0, "0".repeat(64)));
    const head = await auditHead();
    const [now] = await apiDb.execute<{ value: string }>(sql`select public.head_value('2031-05-06'::date, ${head.seq}::bigint, ${head.hash}) as value`);
    expect(now!.value).toBe(headValue("2031-05-06", head.seq, head.hash));
    const listOf = async (name: string) => {
      const [check] = await migrateDb.execute<{ def: string }>(sql`select pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) as def from pg_constraint c where c.conrelid = 'public.head_publications'::regclass and c.conname = ${name}`);
      return [...check!.def.matchAll(/'([a-z0-9_]+)'::text/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
    };
    expect(await listOf("head_publications_kind")).toEqual([...HEAD_KINDS]);
    expect(await listOf("head_publications_witness")).toEqual([...HEAD_WITNESSES]);
    const [rights] = await migrateDb.execute<Record<string, boolean>>(sql`
      select has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.head_publications', 'SELECT') as sel,
             has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.head_publications', 'INSERT') as ins,
             has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.head_publications', 'DELETE') as del,
             has_column_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.head_publications', 'token', 'UPDATE') as token,
             has_column_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.head_publications', 'witnessed_at', 'UPDATE') as witnessed,
             has_column_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.head_publications', 'published_at', 'UPDATE') as published,
             has_column_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.head_publications', 'value', 'UPDATE') as value,
             has_column_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.head_publications', 'chain_seq', 'UPDATE') as place,
             has_column_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.head_publications', 'retired_at', 'UPDATE') as retired,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.head_value(date, bigint, text)', 'EXECUTE') as value_fn,
             has_function_privilege('public', 'public.head_value(date, bigint, text)', 'EXECUTE') as value_pub`);
    expect({ ...rights }).toEqual({ sel: true, ins: true, del: false, token: true, witnessed: true, published: true, value: false, place: false, retired: false, value_fn: true, value_pub: false });
  });

  test("as the API's role the insert is forced: a head of today, its place and value from audit_head as it stands, nothing else; one head row a day", async () => {
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const [row] = await tx.execute<{ day: string; kind: string; chain_seq: number; value: string; witness: string; rest: boolean }>(sql`
        insert into public.head_publications (day, kind, chain_seq, value, witness, token, witnessed_at, published_at, retired_at, last_day)
        values ('2001-02-03', 'restore', 1, ${"f".repeat(64)}, 'test', ${Buffer.from("3003020100", "hex")}, '2001-02-03', '2001-02-03', '2001-02-03', '2001-01-01')
        returning to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as day, kind, chain_seq::int as chain_seq, value, witness,
                  token is null and witnessed_at is null and published_at is null and retired_at is null and last_day is null as rest`);
      const head = await auditHead(tx);
      expect({ ...row }).toEqual({ day: await today(), kind: "head", chain_seq: head.seq, value: headValue(await today(), head.seq, head.hash), witness: "test", rest: true });
      expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`insert into public.head_publications (witness) values ('none')`))))?.code).toBe("23505");
      expect(await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.head_publications (witness) values ('none') on conflict (day, kind) do nothing returning day`)).toHaveLength(0);
      expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`insert into public.head_publications (witness) values ('openssl')`))))?.code).toBe("23514");
    });
  });

  test("as the API's role the token and the publication change once, from null, at the clock's time; nothing else changes, and nothing is deleted", async () => {
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const d = await today();
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.head_publications (witness) values ('rfc3161')`);
      const where = sql`day = ${d}::date and kind = 'head'`;
      const [set] = await tx.execute<{ fresh: boolean }>(sql`update public.head_publications set token = ${Buffer.from(TEST_TOKEN)}, witnessed_at = '2001-01-01' where ${where} returning witnessed_at = now() as fresh`);
      expect(set!.fresh).toBe(true);
      const refused = async (statement: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => (await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(statement))))?.message;
      expect(await refused(sql`update public.head_publications set token = ${Buffer.from("30", "hex")} where ${where}`)).toBe("moderation_column");
      expect(await refused(sql`update public.head_publications set witnessed_at = now() - interval '1 day' where ${where}`)).toBe("moderation_column");
      const [published] = await tx.execute<{ fresh: boolean }>(sql`update public.head_publications set published_at = '2001-01-01' where ${where} returning published_at = now() as fresh`);
      expect(published!.fresh).toBe(true);
      expect(await refused(sql`update public.head_publications set published_at = null where ${where}`)).toBe("moderation_column");
      // Every other column is out of the role's grants: the value, the place, the witness's name, the retirement.
      for (const statement of [
        sql`update public.head_publications set value = ${"0".repeat(64)} where ${where}`,
        sql`update public.head_publications set chain_seq = 1 where ${where}`,
        sql`update public.head_publications set witness = 'none' where ${where}`,
        sql`update public.head_publications set retired_at = now() where ${where}`,
        sql`delete from public.head_publications where ${where}`,
      ]) {
        expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(statement))))?.code).toBe("42501");
      }
    });
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const where = sql`day = (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date and kind = 'head'`;
      // A token without its time, a token larger than 16 KB, and a token on a row whose witness nobody asked are refused.
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.head_publications (witness) values ('none')`);
      expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`update public.head_publications set token = ${Buffer.from("30", "hex")} where ${where}`))))?.code).toBe("23514");
      expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`update public.head_publications set token = ${Buffer.from("30", "hex")}, witnessed_at = now() where ${where}`))))?.code).toBe("23514");
    });
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.head_publications (witness) values ('test')`);
      const big = Buffer.alloc(HEAD_RULES.tokenMaxBytes + 1, 1);
      expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`update public.head_publications set token = ${big}, witnessed_at = now() where day = (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date`))))?.code).toBe("23514");
    });
  });

  test("witness off: the job's day publishes the row named none, mails the keeper the day, the value, the place and the hash, which give the value again, and writes no audit row", async () => {
    const { module, kept } = build({ HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL: KEEPER });
    const before = await auditHead();
    const round = await module.round();
    expect(round.editions).toEqual([]);
    expect(round.head).toMatchObject({ day: await today(), inserted: true, witnessed: null, published: true, mailed: "sent", alerts: [], done: true });
    // The publication is no audit row: it would move the head it publishes.
    expect((await auditHead()).seq).toBe(before.seq);
    const [row] = await headRows();
    expect({ ...row }).toMatchObject({ day: await today(), kind: "head", chain_seq: before.seq, value: headValue(await today(), before.seq, before.hash), witness: "none", token: null, published: true, retired: false });
    expect(kept()).toHaveLength(1);
    const mail = kept()[0]!;
    expect(mail.to).toBe(KEEPER);
    expect(mail.data).toEqual({ day: await today(), value: row!.value, seq: String(before.seq), hash: before.hash, witnessed: "none" });
    // The keeper's check: the day, the place and the hash give the value.
    expect(headValue(mail.data.day!, Number(mail.data.seq), mail.data.hash!)).toBe(mail.data.value);
    // A later round of the same day writes and mails nothing.
    const later = await module.round();
    expect(later.head).toBeNull();
    expect(kept()).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("no keeper's address: the value is published and no mail is sent; the test witness on a closed site stores its token first", async () => {
    const { module, mailer } = build({ HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL: undefined, HEAD_WITNESS: "test", APP_SITE: "closed" });
    const round = await module.round();
    expect(round.head).toMatchObject({ witnessed: "stored", published: true, mailed: "off", done: true });
    expect(mailer.sent).toEqual([]);
    const [row] = await headRows();
    expect([row!.witness, Buffer.from(row!.token!).equals(Buffer.from(TEST_TOKEN)), row!.published]).toEqual(["test", true, true]);
  });

  test("rfc3161 against fakeWitness(): the answer stored as received, and GET /api/public/head offers it as base64 with the day's value and never the place", async () => {
    const fake = await fakeWitness();
    try {
      const witness = witnessFrom({ HEAD_WITNESS: "rfc3161", APP_SITE: "open", HEAD_WITNESS_URL: "https://tsa.example/" }, { url: fake.url });
      const { module, app, kept } = build({ HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL: KEEPER, HEAD_WITNESS: "rfc3161", HEAD_WITNESS_URL: "https://tsa.example/" }, witness);
      const round = await module.round();
      expect(round.head).toMatchObject({ witnessed: "stored", published: true, mailed: "sent", done: true });
      expect(fake.requests).toHaveLength(1);
      const [row] = await headRows();
      expect(fake.requests[0]!.body.subarray(24, 56).toString("hex")).toBe(row!.value);
      expect(Buffer.from(row!.token!).equals(grantedAnswer(fake.requests[0]!.body))).toBe(true);
      expect(kept()[0]!.data.witnessed).toBe("stored");
      const res = await app.request("/api/public/head", { headers: { cookie: "korbat_session=abc" } });
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("public, max-age=3600");
      const body = await res.json();
      const answer = PublicHead.parse(body);
      expect(answer.days).toEqual([{ day: await today(), kind: "head", value: row!.value, witness: "rfc3161", token: grantedAnswer(fake.requests[0]!.body).toString("base64"), retiredOn: null, lastDay: null }]);
      expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.toMatch(/chainSeq|chain_seq|"seq"|hash/);
      // The facts route says the witness is on, and is no test adapter.
      expect(PublicFacts.parse(await (await app.request("/api/public/facts")).json()).witness).toEqual({ on: true, test: false });
    } finally {
      await fake.close();
    }
  });

  test("an authority that does not answer: the value is published without a token, reads none, head_unwitnessed once; a later round asks again and stores the later token", async () => {
    const fake = await fakeWitness();
    try {
      fake.answer("error");
      const witness = witnessFrom({ HEAD_WITNESS: "rfc3161", APP_SITE: "open", HEAD_WITNESS_URL: "https://tsa.example/" }, { url: fake.url });
      const { module, app } = build({ HEAD_WITNESS: "rfc3161", HEAD_WITNESS_URL: "https://tsa.example/" }, witness);
      const first = await module.round();
      expect(first.head).toMatchObject({ witnessed: "unanswered", published: true, alerts: ["head_unwitnessed"], done: false });
      const d = await today();
      expect((await alerts()).map((a) => [a.kind, a.facts])).toEqual([["head_unwitnessed", { day: `${d}T00:00:00.000Z` }]]);
      const shown = PublicHead.parse(await (await app.request("/api/public/head")).json());
      expect(shown.days.map((entry) => [entry.witness, entry.token])).toEqual([["none", null]]);
      // The same day's next round asks again; a second failure writes no second alert within the day.
      const second = await module.round();
      expect(second.head).toMatchObject({ witnessed: "unanswered", published: false, alerts: [], done: false });
      expect(await alerts()).toHaveLength(1);
      fake.answer("ok");
      const third = await module.round();
      expect(third.head).toMatchObject({ witnessed: "stored", done: true });
      expect(fake.requests).toHaveLength(3);
      const [row] = await headRows();
      expect([row!.witness, row!.token === null]).toEqual(["rfc3161", false]);
      expect(PublicHead.parse(await (await app.request("/api/public/head")).json()).days[0]!.witness).toBe("rfc3161");
    } finally {
      await fake.close();
    }
  });

  test("head_missed: the day's first round finds the day before without a published value while an earlier day has one; on the head's first day nothing is missed", async () => {
    const d = await today();
    const first = build();
    expect((await first.module.round()).head).toMatchObject({ alerts: [] });
    expect(await alerts()).toEqual([]);
    await cleanUp();
    // Three days ago a value was published; the day before today has none.
    const earlier = dayBefore(d, 3);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into public.head_publications (day, kind, chain_seq, value, witness, published_at) values (${earlier}::date, 'head', 0, ${headValue(earlier, 0, "0".repeat(64))}, 'none', now())`);
    day++;
    const next = build();
    expect((await next.module.round()).head).toMatchObject({ alerts: ["head_missed"] });
    expect((await alerts()).map((a) => [a.kind, a.facts])).toEqual([["head_missed", { day: `${dayBefore(d, 1)}T00:00:00.000Z` }]]);
  });

  test("GET /api/public/head: the published rows of the last 30 days, newest first, a restore with its last day and a retired value with its day; nothing unpublished, nothing older", async () => {
    const d = await today();
    const value = (n: number) => headValue(dayBefore(d, n), n, "0".repeat(64));
    const at = (n: number) => sql`${dayBefore(d, n)}::date`;
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`
      insert into public.head_publications (day, kind, chain_seq, value, witness, published_at, retired_at, last_day) values
        (${at(1)}, 'head', 1, ${value(1)}, 'none', now(), null, null),
        (${at(2)}, 'restore', 2, ${value(2)}, 'none', now(), null, ${at(5)}),
        (${at(3)}, 'head', null, ${value(3)}, 'none', now(), now(), null),
        (${at(4)}, 'head', 4, ${value(4)}, 'none', null, null, null),
        (${at(HEAD_RULES.shownDays)}, 'head', 30, ${value(HEAD_RULES.shownDays)}, 'none', now(), null, null),
        (${at(HEAD_RULES.shownDays - 1)}, 'head', 29, ${value(HEAD_RULES.shownDays - 1)}, 'none', now(), null, null)`);
    const { app } = build();
    const answer = PublicHead.parse(await (await app.request("/api/public/head")).json());
    expect(answer.days).toEqual([
      { day: dayBefore(d, 1), kind: "head", value: value(1), witness: "none", token: null, retiredOn: null, lastDay: null },
      { day: dayBefore(d, 2), kind: "restore", value: value(2), witness: "none", token: null, retiredOn: null, lastDay: dayBefore(d, 5) },
      { day: dayBefore(d, 3), kind: "head", value: value(3), witness: "none", token: null, retiredOn: d, lastDay: null },
      { day: dayBefore(d, HEAD_RULES.shownDays - 1), kind: "head", value: value(HEAD_RULES.shownDays - 1), witness: "none", token: null, retiredOn: null, lastDay: null },
    ]);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/transparency/fake-witness.ts`

```ts
import { createServer, type IncomingMessage, type ServerResponse } from "node:http";
import type { AddressInfo } from "node:net";

/** One request the stand-in took: its method, its path, its content type and its body's bytes. */
export interface WitnessRequest {
  method: string;
  path: string;
  contentType: string | null;
  body: Buffer;
}

/**
 * How the stand-in answers: with a TimeStampResp whose status is granted and which carries a token (`ok`), with one whose
 * status is rejection and which carries none (`refused`), with a server error (`error`), with a granted answer larger
 * than any token korbat keeps (`huge`), or not at all, holding the request open until it is closed (`hang`).
 */
export type WitnessAnswer = "ok" | "refused" | "error" | "huge" | "hang";

/** A DER length: short below 128, else 0x81 or 0x82 and the bytes. */
function derLength(n: number): number[] {
  if (n < 0x80) return [n];
  if (n < 0x100) return [0x81, n];
  return [0x82, n >> 8, n & 0xff];
}
const tlv = (tag: number, content: Buffer) => Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([tag, ...derLength(content.length)]), content]);

/**
 * The stand-in's granted answer for a request: a TimeStampResp of status 0 (granted) whose token is a SEQUENCE holding the
 * request's own bytes, so a test can tell which request an answer belongs to. It proves nothing: the adapter keeps an
 * answer unparsed beyond its status, and only a real authority's token is checked, with openssl, by whoever reads it.
 */
export function grantedAnswer(request: Buffer, padding = 0): Buffer {
  const status = tlv(0x30, Buffer.from([0x02, 0x01, 0x00]));
  const token = tlv(0x30, Buffer.concat([tlv(0x04, request), tlv(0x04, Buffer.alloc(padding, 0x41))]));
  return tlv(0x30, Buffer.concat([status, token]));
}

/** A rejection (status 2) with no token, as an authority answers a request it will not stamp. */
export const REFUSED_ANSWER = tlv(0x30, tlv(0x30, Buffer.from([0x02, 0x01, 0x02])));

/**
 * fakeWitness() (3d design, section 12; Task 5): a local HTTP server that stands in for a timestamp authority. It
 * records each request with its body, and answers as it is told. Its `url` is what the rfc3161 adapter is given in place
 * of HEAD_WITNESS_URL, which the configuration holds to https.
 */
export async function fakeWitness(): Promise<{
  url: string;
  requests: WitnessRequest[];
  answer(how: WitnessAnswer): void;
  close(): Promise<void>;
}> {
  const requests: WitnessRequest[] = [];
  const open = new Set<ServerResponse>();
  let how: WitnessAnswer = "ok";
  const server = createServer((req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse) => {
    const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
    req.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => chunks.push(chunk));
    req.on("end", () => {
      const body = Buffer.concat(chunks);
      requests.push({ method: req.method ?? "", path: req.url ?? "", contentType: req.headers["content-type"] ?? null, body });
      if (how === "hang") {
        open.add(res);
        return;
      }
      if (how === "error") {
        res.writeHead(500, { "content-type": "text/plain" });
        res.end("the stand-in failed");
        return;
      }
      const answer = how === "refused" ? REFUSED_ANSWER : grantedAnswer(body, how === "huge" ? 20_000 : 0);
      res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "application/timestamp-reply" });
      res.end(answer);
    });
  });
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve));
  const { port } = server.address() as AddressInfo;
  return {
    url: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}/tsa`,
    requests,
    answer(next) {
      how = next;
    },
    async close() {
      for (const res of open) res.destroy();
      server.closeAllConnections();
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.close(() => resolve()));
    },
  };
}
```

### Create `apps/api/test/transparency/head.test.ts`

```ts
import pino from "pino";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { HEAD_RULES, PublicHead, type HeadWitness } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { KeeperMailResult, KeeperMessage } from "../../src/auth";
import { headValue, publicHead, publishHead, type HeadDayRow, type HeadRepo, type HeadToday } from "../../src/transparency/head";
import { TEST_TOKEN, witnessFrom, type WitnessAdapter } from "../../src/transparency/witness";

/**
 * The audit head's daily value (3d design, sections 2 row 9, 7.7 and 10.6; 12.1 row 24; Task 5), without a database: the
 * digest over the tag, the day, the place and the hash, held to vectors that openssl computed; the public answer, which
 * never holds the place; and one day's pass of the job over a stand-in of its statements: the insert, the witness, the
 * publication from null, the keeper's mail once from the round that published, the later rounds that ask the witness
 * again while the token is null, and the two alerts.
 */
const VALUE = "917907fc36f065a78e0b730230eac9c4f1c2882c77efc7a868a65ee336e0899e";

describe("headValue", () => {
  test("the hex SHA-256 of korbat.head.v2, the day, the place and the hash, each after a line feed, as openssl computes it", () => {
    // printf 'korbat.head.v2<LF>2026-10-18<LF>42<LF><hash>' | openssl dgst -sha256 (OpenSSL 3.5.4), and the same for an empty log.
    expect(headValue("2026-10-18", 42, "24cc975360df565521f1acca5b67f924d33ca0a0999355f667c4c289b1632fe1")).toBe(VALUE);
    expect(headValue("2026-10-19", 0, "0".repeat(64))).toBe("a216ea784e796bfbc28daf1df377d1e3db66e48ec1c710674fd01cb236e10b56");
    expect(HEAD_RULES.tag).toBe("korbat.head.v2");
  });

  test("two days without a new audit row give two values, and neither shows the place or the hash", () => {
    const hash = "24cc975360df565521f1acca5b67f924d33ca0a0999355f667c4c289b1632fe1";
    const saturday = headValue("2026-10-17", 42, hash);
    const sunday = headValue("2026-10-18", 42, hash);
    expect(saturday).not.toBe(sunday);
    for (const value of [saturday, sunday]) {
      expect(value).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
      expect(value).not.toContain(hash.slice(0, 8));
    }
  });
});

describe("publicHead: GET /api/public/head's answer", () => {
  const row = (over: Partial<HeadDayRow> = {}): HeadDayRow => ({ day: "2026-10-18", kind: "head", value: VALUE, witness: "rfc3161", token: Buffer.from("3003020100", "hex"), retiredOn: null, lastDay: null, ...over });

  test("each row's day, kind, value, witness, token as base64, the day it was retired and a restore's last day; never the place", () => {
    const answer = publicHead([row(), row({ day: "2026-10-17", witness: "rfc3161", token: null }), row({ day: "2026-10-16", kind: "restore", witness: "none", token: null, lastDay: "2026-10-12" }), row({ day: "2026-10-15", witness: "none", token: null, retiredOn: "2026-10-16" })]);
    expect(PublicHead.parse(answer)).toEqual(answer);
    expect(answer.days).toEqual([
      { day: "2026-10-18", kind: "head", value: VALUE, witness: "rfc3161", token: "MAMCAQA=", retiredOn: null, lastDay: null },
      // A witness that was asked and did not answer reads none: the row is witnessed by nobody.
      { day: "2026-10-17", kind: "head", value: VALUE, witness: "none", token: null, retiredOn: null, lastDay: null },
      { day: "2026-10-16", kind: "restore", value: VALUE, witness: "none", token: null, retiredOn: null, lastDay: "2026-10-12" },
      { day: "2026-10-15", kind: "head", value: VALUE, witness: "none", token: null, retiredOn: "2026-10-16", lastDay: null },
    ]);
    expect(JSON.stringify(answer)).not.toMatch(/chainSeq|seq|hash|place/);
  });
});

/** A stand-in of the job's statements over one day's rows, as the database would answer them. */
function fakeRepo(options: { missed?: string | null; place?: { seq: number; hash: string } | null } = {}) {
  const state = {
    row: null as null | { value: string; witness: HeadWitness; token: Uint8Array | null; published: boolean },
    alerts: [] as { kind: string; day: string }[],
    calls: [] as string[],
  };
  const DAY = "2026-10-18";
  const today = (inserted: boolean): HeadToday => ({ inserted, day: DAY, value: state.row!.value, witness: state.row!.witness, witnessed: state.row!.token !== null, published: state.row!.published });
  const repo: HeadRepo = {
    async headInsert(witness) {
      state.calls.push("insert");
      if (state.row) return today(false);
      state.row = { value: VALUE, witness, token: null, published: false };
      return today(true);
    },
    async headWitnessed(day, token) {
      state.calls.push("witnessed");
      expect(day).toBe(DAY);
      if (state.row!.token !== null) return false;
      state.row!.token = token;
      return true;
    },
    async headPublish(day) {
      state.calls.push("publish");
      expect(day).toBe(DAY);
      if (state.row!.published) return null;
      state.row!.published = true;
      return { witnessed: state.row!.token !== null };
    },
    async headPlace() {
      state.calls.push("place");
      return options.place === undefined ? { seq: 42, hash: "24cc975360df565521f1acca5b67f924d33ca0a0999355f667c4c289b1632fe1" } : options.place;
    },
    async headMissed() {
      state.calls.push("missed");
      return options.missed ?? null;
    },
    async headAlert(kind, day) {
      // F's daily rule: one row of a kind in 24 hours.
      if (state.alerts.some((alert) => alert.kind === kind)) return false;
      state.alerts.push({ kind, day });
      return true;
    },
  };
  return { repo, state };
}

/** A witness that answers as the test says, counting its calls. */
function scripted(answers: (Uint8Array | null)[]): WitnessAdapter & { calls: string[] } {
  const calls: string[] = [];
  return {
    mode: "rfc3161",
    name: "rfc3161",
    calls,
    async witness(value) {
      calls.push(value);
      return answers.shift() ?? null;
    },
  };
}

/** The keeper's mail as the auth module's mailKeeper is given it: recorded, and answered as it would. */
function keeper(result: KeeperMailResult = "sent") {
  const sent: KeeperMessage[] = [];
  return { sent, mailKeeper: async (message: KeeperMessage) => (sent.push(message), result) };
}

const log = pino({ level: "silent" });

describe("one day's pass of the head (7.7)", () => {
  test("witness off: the row named none, published, and the keeper mailed once with the day, the value, the place and the hash; a later round changes nothing", async () => {
    const { repo, state } = fakeRepo();
    const mail = keeper();
    const witness = witnessFrom({ HEAD_WITNESS: "off", APP_SITE: "open" });
    const first = await publishHead({ repo, witness, mailKeeper: mail.mailKeeper, log }, { firstOfDay: true });
    expect(first).toEqual({ day: "2026-10-18", inserted: true, witnessed: null, published: true, mailed: "sent", alerts: [], done: true });
    expect(state.row).toMatchObject({ witness: "none", token: null, published: true });
    expect(mail.sent).toEqual([{ template: "head_published", day: "2026-10-18", value: VALUE, seq: 42, hash: "24cc975360df565521f1acca5b67f924d33ca0a0999355f667c4c289b1632fe1", witnessed: false }]);
    const again = await publishHead({ repo, witness, mailKeeper: mail.mailKeeper, log }, { firstOfDay: false });
    expect(again).toEqual({ day: "2026-10-18", inserted: false, witnessed: null, published: false, mailed: null, alerts: [], done: true });
    expect(mail.sent).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("the test witness: its token stored before the value is published, and the keeper's mail says a timestamp is stored", async () => {
    const { repo, state } = fakeRepo();
    const mail = keeper();
    const witness = witnessFrom({ HEAD_WITNESS: "test", APP_SITE: "closed" });
    const pass = await publishHead({ repo, witness, mailKeeper: mail.mailKeeper, log }, { firstOfDay: true });
    expect(pass).toMatchObject({ inserted: true, witnessed: "stored", published: true, mailed: "sent", alerts: [], done: true });
    expect(Buffer.from(state.row!.token!).equals(Buffer.from(TEST_TOKEN))).toBe(true);
    expect(state.calls).toEqual(["insert", "missed", "witnessed", "publish", "place"]);
    expect(mail.sent[0]).toMatchObject({ witnessed: true });
  });

  test("a witness that does not answer: published without a token, head_unwitnessed once; a later round asks again and a later token is stored, the mail not sent twice", async () => {
    const { repo, state } = fakeRepo();
    const mail = keeper();
    const witness = scripted([null, null, Buffer.from("300a3003020100300302010a", "hex")]);
    const first = await publishHead({ repo, witness, mailKeeper: mail.mailKeeper, log }, { firstOfDay: true });
    expect(first).toMatchObject({ witnessed: "unanswered", published: true, mailed: "sent", alerts: ["head_unwitnessed"], done: false });
    expect(state.alerts).toEqual([{ kind: "head_unwitnessed", day: "2026-10-18" }]);
    expect(mail.sent).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ witnessed: false })]);
    const second = await publishHead({ repo, witness, mailKeeper: mail.mailKeeper, log }, { firstOfDay: false });
    expect(second).toMatchObject({ witnessed: "unanswered", published: false, mailed: null, alerts: [], done: false });
    const third = await publishHead({ repo, witness, mailKeeper: mail.mailKeeper, log }, { firstOfDay: false });
    expect(third).toMatchObject({ witnessed: "stored", published: false, mailed: null, alerts: [], done: true });
    expect(witness.calls).toEqual([VALUE, VALUE, VALUE]);
    expect(state.row!.token).not.toBeNull();
    expect(mail.sent).toHaveLength(1);
    // Once the token is stored nothing is asked again.
    await publishHead({ repo, witness, mailKeeper: mail.mailKeeper, log }, { firstOfDay: false });
    expect(witness.calls).toHaveLength(3);
  });

  test("a row born while the witness was off is never witnessed later the same day: its name says nobody was asked", async () => {
    const { repo, state } = fakeRepo();
    await publishHead({ repo, witness: witnessFrom({ HEAD_WITNESS: "off", APP_SITE: "open" }), mailKeeper: keeper().mailKeeper, log }, { firstOfDay: true });
    const witness = scripted([Buffer.from("300a3003020100300302010a", "hex")]);
    const pass = await publishHead({ repo, witness, mailKeeper: keeper().mailKeeper, log }, { firstOfDay: false });
    expect(pass).toMatchObject({ witnessed: null, done: true });
    expect(witness.calls).toEqual([]);
    expect(state.row!.token).toBeNull();
  });

  test("a day's first round alerts head_missed when the day before has no published value; later rounds do not look", async () => {
    const { repo, state } = fakeRepo({ missed: "2026-10-17" });
    const witness = witnessFrom({ HEAD_WITNESS: "off", APP_SITE: "open" });
    const first = await publishHead({ repo, witness, mailKeeper: keeper().mailKeeper, log }, { firstOfDay: true });
    expect(first.alerts).toEqual(["head_missed"]);
    expect(state.alerts).toEqual([{ kind: "head_missed", day: "2026-10-17" }]);
    state.calls.length = 0;
    await publishHead({ repo, witness, mailKeeper: keeper().mailKeeper, log }, { firstOfDay: false });
    expect(state.calls).not.toContain("missed");
  });

  test("no keeper's address: published all the same, and the pass says no mail went; a place whose hash does not give the value: no mail at all", async () => {
    const off = fakeRepo();
    const none = keeper("off");
    const pass = await publishHead({ repo: off.repo, witness: witnessFrom({ HEAD_WITNESS: "off", APP_SITE: "open" }), mailKeeper: none.mailKeeper, log }, { firstOfDay: true });
    expect(pass).toMatchObject({ published: true, mailed: "off", done: true });
    const wrong = fakeRepo({ place: null });
    const mail = keeper();
    const unverified = await publishHead({ repo: wrong.repo, witness: witnessFrom({ HEAD_WITNESS: "off", APP_SITE: "open" }), mailKeeper: mail.mailKeeper, log }, { firstOfDay: true });
    expect(unverified).toMatchObject({ published: true, mailed: "unverified" });
    expect(mail.sent).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/transparency/witness.test.ts`

```ts
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { HEAD_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { TEST_TOKEN, timestampRequest, witnessFrom, type WitnessSettings } from "../../src/transparency/witness";
import { REFUSED_ANSWER, fakeWitness, grantedAnswer } from "./fake-witness";

/**
 * The head's witness adapter (3d design, sections 2 row 9, 5 "The adapters" and 7.7; 12.1 row 27 and 12.2; Task 5):
 * `off`, `test` and `rfc3161`, chosen by HEAD_WITNESS. The request is a fixed DER template of under 100 bytes with the
 * value's own 32 bytes as its imprint, so `openssl ts -verify -digest <value>` checks the proof; the `test` adapter
 * answers a fixed token and is built only on a site that is closed; `rfc3161` sends one request, bounded at
 * HEAD_RULES.witnessTimeoutMs, here against fakeWitness(), and keeps the answer unparsed beyond its status, at most
 * HEAD_RULES.tokenMaxBytes. Every failure answers null.
 */
// The lab of [tr.verify] (the report of Task 5): the value of 2026-10-18 at place 42, the request it sent to a local test
// authority, which `openssl ts -query -text` read as version 1, sha256, this imprint and "Certificate required: yes".
const VALUE = "917907fc36f065a78e0b730230eac9c4f1c2882c77efc7a868a65ee336e0899e";
const LAB_REQUEST = "30390201013031300d060960864801650304020105000420917907fc36f065a78e0b730230eac9c4f1c2882c77efc7a868a65ee336e0899e0101ff";
const closed = (over: Partial<WitnessSettings> = {}): WitnessSettings => ({ HEAD_WITNESS: "test", APP_SITE: "closed", HEAD_WITNESS_URL: undefined, ...over });
const rfc3161 = (url: string): WitnessSettings => ({ HEAD_WITNESS: "rfc3161", APP_SITE: "open", HEAD_WITNESS_URL: url });

describe("the request template", () => {
  test("a TimeStampReq of 59 bytes: version 1, SHA-256 with its NULL parameters, the value's own 32 bytes, and the certificate asked for", () => {
    const request = Buffer.from(timestampRequest(VALUE));
    expect(request.toString("hex")).toBe(LAB_REQUEST);
    expect(request.length).toBe(59);
    expect(request.length).toBeLessThan(100);
    // The imprint is the value itself, read as the 32 bytes its hex spells: what -digest {value} compares.
    expect(request.subarray(24, 56).toString("hex")).toBe(VALUE);
    // Only the imprint differs from one value to the next: no nonce, no time, nothing of the server.
    const other = Buffer.from(timestampRequest("0".repeat(64)));
    expect(Buffer.concat([other.subarray(0, 24), other.subarray(56)]).equals(Buffer.concat([request.subarray(0, 24), request.subarray(56)]))).toBe(true);
  });

  test("it takes a value of 64 lower-case hexadecimal characters and nothing else", () => {
    for (const bad of ["", VALUE.toUpperCase(), VALUE.slice(2), `${VALUE}00`, "z".repeat(64)]) expect(() => timestampRequest(bad), bad).toThrow(/value/);
  });
});

describe("the witness adapter", () => {
  test("off: the default; it names nobody and sends nothing", async () => {
    const off = witnessFrom({ HEAD_WITNESS: "off", APP_SITE: "open" });
    expect([off.mode, off.name]).toEqual(["off", "none"]);
    await expect(off.witness(VALUE)).rejects.toThrow(/off/);
  });

  test("test: a fixed token for any value, a copy each time, on a site that is closed", async () => {
    const adapter = witnessFrom(closed());
    expect([adapter.mode, adapter.name]).toEqual(["test", "test"]);
    const first = await adapter.witness(VALUE);
    expect(Buffer.from(first!).equals(Buffer.from(TEST_TOKEN))).toBe(true);
    first![0] = 0;
    expect(Buffer.from((await adapter.witness("0".repeat(64)))!).equals(Buffer.from(TEST_TOKEN))).toBe(true);
    expect(TEST_TOKEN.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(HEAD_RULES.tokenMaxBytes);
  });

  test("test is refused while the app's site is open, in the process as at start", () => {
    expect(() => witnessFrom(closed({ APP_SITE: "open" }))).toThrow(/APP_SITE/);
  });

  test("rfc3161 is refused without its address", () => {
    expect(() => witnessFrom({ HEAD_WITNESS: "rfc3161", APP_SITE: "open", HEAD_WITNESS_URL: undefined })).toThrow(/HEAD_WITNESS_URL/);
  });
});

describe("rfc3161 against fakeWitness()", () => {
  let fake: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof fakeWitness>>;
  beforeAll(async () => {
    fake = await fakeWitness();
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await fake.close();
  });

  test("an answer: one POST of the request, as application/timestamp-query, and the whole TimeStampResp kept as it came", async () => {
    fake.answer("ok");
    fake.requests.length = 0;
    const adapter = witnessFrom(rfc3161("https://tsa.example/"), { url: fake.url });
    expect([adapter.mode, adapter.name]).toEqual(["rfc3161", "rfc3161"]);
    const token = await adapter.witness(VALUE);
    expect(fake.requests).toHaveLength(1);
    expect([fake.requests[0]!.method, fake.requests[0]!.path, fake.requests[0]!.contentType]).toEqual(["POST", "/tsa", "application/timestamp-query"]);
    expect(fake.requests[0]!.body.toString("hex")).toBe(LAB_REQUEST);
    expect(Buffer.from(token!).equals(grantedAnswer(Buffer.from(LAB_REQUEST, "hex")))).toBe(true);
  });

  test("a refusal, a server error and an answer larger than HEAD_RULES.tokenMaxBytes each answer null", async () => {
    const adapter = witnessFrom(rfc3161("https://tsa.example/"), { url: fake.url });
    for (const how of ["refused", "error", "huge"] as const) {
      fake.answer(how);
      expect(await adapter.witness(VALUE), how).toBeNull();
    }
    expect(REFUSED_ANSWER.length).toBeLessThan(16);
  });

  test("an authority that does not answer: null once the timeout has passed, and nothing thrown", async () => {
    fake.answer("hang");
    const adapter = witnessFrom(rfc3161("https://tsa.example/"), { url: fake.url, timeoutMs: 300 });
    const started = Date.now();
    expect(await adapter.witness(VALUE)).toBeNull();
    expect(Date.now() - started).toBeLessThan(5_000);
    fake.answer("ok");
  });

  test("a closed port answers null; an answer that is no TimeStampResp, or a granted one without its token, answers null", async () => {
    const refusedPort = witnessFrom(rfc3161("https://tsa.example/"), { url: "http://127.0.0.1:1/tsa" });
    expect(await refusedPort.witness(VALUE)).toBeNull();
    const answering = (body: Uint8Array) =>
      witnessFrom(rfc3161("https://tsa.example/"), { url: "https://tsa.example/", fetch: async () => new Response(body, { status: 200 }) });
    for (const body of [Buffer.from("not der"), Buffer.from("3003020100", "hex"), Buffer.from("300530030201", "hex"), Buffer.alloc(0)]) {
      expect(await answering(body).witness(VALUE), body.toString("hex")).toBeNull();
    }
    // Status 1, granted with modifications, is a token too.
    const withMods = Buffer.from("300a3003020101300302010a", "hex");
    expect(Buffer.from((await answering(withMods).witness(VALUE))!).equals(withMods)).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

### Create `packages/contracts/test/head.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { ALERT_KINDS, ALERT_KIND_LIST, HEAD_KINDS, HEAD_RULES, HEAD_WITNESSES, PublicHead, SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS, alertPlaceholders, isTimeFact, renderAlert } from "../src/index";

/**
 * 3d Task 5, the audit head's daily value (design, sections 7.7, 10.1, 10.6 and 18, W.7): the head's constants, the two
 * closed lists of head_publications, the public answer, which never holds the place, and the two alerts the
 * transparency job writes, whose one fact is a day.
 */
describe("the head's contracts (3d Task 5)", () => {
  test("HEAD_RULES: the digest's tag, thirty days shown, the witness bounded at ten seconds, a token of at most 16 KB", () => {
    expect({ ...HEAD_RULES }).toEqual({ tag: "korbat.head.v2", shownDays: 30, witnessTimeoutMs: 10_000, tokenMaxBytes: 16_384 });
    expect([...HEAD_KINDS]).toEqual(["head", "restore"]);
    expect([...HEAD_WITNESSES]).toEqual(["none", "rfc3161", "test"]);
  });

  const VALUE = "917907fc36f065a78e0b730230eac9c4f1c2882c77efc7a868a65ee336e0899e";
  const row = { day: "2026-10-18", kind: "head", value: VALUE, witness: "rfc3161", token: "MAMCAQA=", retiredOn: null, lastDay: null } as const;

  test("PublicHead: a day, its kind, its value, who witnessed it with the token, when a restore retired it and, on a restore, the last day that still fits", () => {
    expect(PublicHead.safeParse({ days: [row] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(PublicHead.safeParse({ days: [] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(PublicHead.safeParse({ days: [{ ...row, witness: "none", token: null }, { ...row, kind: "restore", lastDay: "2026-10-12", retiredOn: null }] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(PublicHead.safeParse({ days: [{ ...row, retiredOn: "2026-10-19" }] }).success).toBe(true);
    // Never the place, the hash or anything a row does not have.
    for (const extra of [{ chainSeq: 41 }, { seq: 41 }, { hash: VALUE }, { publishedAt: "2026-10-18T07:01:00.000Z" }]) {
      expect(PublicHead.safeParse({ days: [{ ...row, ...extra }] }).success, Object.keys(extra)[0]).toBe(false);
    }
    for (const bad of [{ value: VALUE.toUpperCase() }, { value: VALUE.slice(1) }, { witness: "tsa" }, { kind: "retired" }, { day: "18.10.2026" }, { token: "not base64!" }]) {
      expect(PublicHead.safeParse({ days: [{ ...row, ...bad }] }).success, JSON.stringify(bad)).toBe(false);
    }
    // A token is at most HEAD_RULES.tokenMaxBytes bytes, as base64: four characters for each three bytes.
    const groups = Math.ceil(HEAD_RULES.tokenMaxBytes / 3);
    expect(PublicHead.safeParse({ days: [{ ...row, token: `${"A".repeat(groups * 4 - 4)}AA==` }] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(PublicHead.safeParse({ days: [{ ...row, token: "A".repeat(groups * 4 + 4) }] }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("head_unwitnessed and head_missed (W.7): the transparency job's two alerts, a day each", () => {
  const now = new Date("2026-10-18T09:00:00.000Z");

  test("they follow edge_purge_failed at the end of the list, a push and a sentence to every staff account, with the one fact day", () => {
    expect(ALERT_KIND_LIST.slice(-3)).toEqual(["edge_purge_failed", "head_unwitnessed", "head_missed"]);
    for (const kind of ["head_unwitnessed", "head_missed"] as const) {
      expect(ALERT_KINDS[kind], kind).toEqual({ priority: 3, scope: "all", legs: ["push", "mail"], mail: "sentence", facts: ["day"] });
      expect(SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS, kind).toContain(kind);
      expect(alertPlaceholders(kind), kind).toEqual(["day"]);
    }
    // The day is the day's first instant in the row (alert_outbox's facts hold counts and instants), so it is a time fact.
    expect(isTimeFact("day")).toBe(true);
  });

  test("the day prints as a date, whether it is today's or an earlier one, never as a time of day", () => {
    expect(renderAlert("head_unwitnessed", { day: "2026-10-18T00:00:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "A daily value has no outside timestamp",
      sentence: "The audit log's value of 2026-10-18 was published without an outside timestamp: the timestamp authority did not answer.",
      todo: "Nothing to do for one day. If it repeats, the operator checks the authority's address.",
    });
    expect(renderAlert("head_missed", { day: "2026-10-17T00:00:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "No daily value was published",
      sentence: "No value of the audit log was published for 2026-10-17.",
      todo: "The operator checks that the API ran at the dispatch hour. The keeper notes the gap; the page shows it.",
    });
    // Two sets of facts differ in their digits alone.
    const a = renderAlert("head_missed", { day: "2026-10-13T00:00:00.000Z" }, now).sentence;
    const b = renderAlert("head_missed", { day: "2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z" }, now).sentence;
    expect(a).not.toBe(b);
    expect(a.replace(/[0-9]/g, "")).toBe(b.replace(/[0-9]/g, ""));
  });

  test("a day that is no instant, or a count in its place, is refused: an alert never goes out with a hole", () => {
    expect(() => renderAlert("head_missed", { day: "2026-10-17" }, now)).toThrow(/day/);
    expect(() => renderAlert("head_missed", { day: 17 }, now)).toThrow(/day/);
    expect(() => renderAlert("head_unwitnessed", {}, now)).toThrow(/day/);
  });
});
```

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";

import { ALERT_RULES, ALERT_TEXTS, EDGE_CACHE, EDGE_RULES, HEAD_RULES, ORDER_RULES, RECIPIENT_RULES, REPLY_AIM_HOURS, RETENTION, STANDING_RULES, TRANSPARENCY_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { AUTOMATION_WORDS } from "../src/messages";

/**
 * The README's moderation runbook and the console's home screen say the same thing (3c design, section 13, Task 12).
 * When decided items wait for the daily release longer than it ever takes, or an erasure is more than a day late, the
 * home screen shows the count with the runbook's sentence for it, and each sentence is a constant of the screen. This
 * test reads README.md from the repository's root and holds the runbook to the same two constants, word for word, so
 * that what staff are told on the screen is what the operator reads in the runbook: whoever changes one changes both.
 */
const README = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..", "..", "README.md");

/** Markdown's code mark. The README sets a log line or a setting in code marks; the console shows the same words as plain text. */
const CODE_MARK = "`";

/** A text as its reader sees it: without the code marks. Nothing else is changed, so every word and every sign must agree. */
const withoutCodeMarks = (text: string): string => text.split(CODE_MARK).join("");

/** The README's lines, as written. */
function readmeLines(): string[] {
  return readFileSync(README, "utf8").split("\n");
}

/** The lines of the README's section "Moderation": from its heading to the next heading of the same level. */
function moderationSection(): string[] {
  const lines = readmeLines();
  const start = lines.indexOf("## Moderation");
  if (start === -1) return [];
  const rest = lines.slice(start + 1);
  const end = rest.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith("## "));
  return end === -1 ? rest : rest.slice(0, end);
}

/** The section's runbook as its reader sees it: every line after "The runbook:", without the code marks. */
function moderationRunbook(): string {
  const section = moderationSection();
  const start = section.indexOf("The runbook:");
  return start === -1 ? "" : withoutCodeMarks(section.slice(start + 1).join("\n"));
}

/** How often `part` stands in `text`. */
const count = (text: string, part: string): number => text.split(part).length - 1;

describe("the README's moderation runbook says what the home screen says", () => {

  });

  test("neither constant holds a code mark or a line break, so reading the README without its code marks hides no difference", () => {
    for (const [name, sentence] of sentences) {
      expect(sentence, name).not.toContain(CODE_MARK);
      expect(sentence, name).not.toContain("\n");
      // A whole sentence: it opens with "A count of" and ends in a full stop, as the runbook's bullet writes it.
      expect(sentence.startsWith("A count of "), name).toBe(true);
      expect(sentence.endsWith("."), name).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  for (const [name, sentence] of sentences) {

      expect(moderationRunbook()).toContain(sentence);

    test(`the sentence for ${name} stands once in the README, in that runbook: no second copy can drift from it`, () => {
      expect(count(withoutCodeMarks(readmeLines().join("\n")), sentence)).toBe(1);
      expect(count(moderationRunbook(), sentence)).toBe(1);

});

/**

 * is the section "Authorities' orders", Upgrading from its 3f paragraph on (Task 1), Restoring's block "Restoring with
 * the keeper's copy" (Task 6) and Before going public's owner's list. Every number in it is a number of ORDER_RULES or
 * ALERT_RULES: a table holds each in its sentence, and every other run of digits is refused but for what names a
 * reference (an article, a research finding, a row of the design's section 2, a check P1 to P8, a list's numbering, a
 * path, a date), so the README cannot keep a number the constants changed. A setting is written as the operator sets it
 * in infra/.env, an API setting with the prefix Compose maps. A section added to 3f's text joins its list here.
 */
const FENCE = "```";

/** The lines of a "## " section of the README, from its heading to the next heading of the same level. */
function sectionLines(heading: string): string[] {
  const lines = readmeLines();
  const start = lines.indexOf(heading);
  if (start === -1) return [];
  const rest = lines.slice(start + 1);
  const end = rest.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith("## "));
  return end === -1 ? rest : rest.slice(0, end);
}
/** A section's lines from the first that begins with these words to the section's end, or to the first that begins with `until`. */
function linesFrom(lines: string[], lead: string, until?: string): string[] {
  const start = lines.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith(lead));
  if (start === -1) return [];
  const rest = lines.slice(start);
  const end = until === undefined ? -1 : rest.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith(until));
  return end === -1 ? rest : rest.slice(0, end);
}
/** Lines without their fenced code: a command's own numbers and words are not the runbook's. */
function withoutFences(lines: string[]): string[] {
  let inside = false;
  return lines.filter((line) => {
    if (line.startsWith(FENCE)) {
      inside = !inside;
      return false;
    }
    return !inside;
  });
}

const ORDERS_HEADING = "## Authorities' orders";
const ORDERS_TITLES = [

  "On call.",

/** 3f's text, part by part, without code marks and fenced code. */
function ordersParts(): Record<"orders" | "upgrading" | "restoring" | "owners", string> {
  const read = (lines: string[]) => withoutCodeMarks(withoutFences(lines).join("\n"));
  return {
    orders: read(sectionLines(ORDERS_HEADING)),
    upgrading: read(linesFrom(sectionLines("## Upgrading"), "Authorities' orders and the alert channel (sub-project 3f)")),
    restoring: read(linesFrom(sectionLines("## Restoring"), "**Restoring with the keeper's copy**")),
    owners: read(linesFrom(sectionLines("## Before going public"), OWNERS_LEAD, "Set these in")),
  };
}
const ordersText = (): string => Object.values(ordersParts()).join("\n");

/** A number in a sentence as the README writes it, and the constant it is. */
const O = ORDER_RULES;

  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays", part: "orders", phrase: `the address is kept for at most ${O.reportHoldDays} days` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays", part: "upgrading", phrase: `keeps its address, and nothing else, for at most ${O.reportHoldDays} days` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.copyOverdueHours", part: "orders", phrase: `once the newest copy is more than ${O.copyOverdueHours} hours old` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.quietMinutes", part: "owners", phrase: `bounded only by the quiet period of ${O.quietMinutes} minutes` },
];

/** What names a reference and is no number of the runbook's, taken out before the digits are counted; only the second keeps a group, the character before the name. */
const REFERENCES: RegExp[] = [
  // A path, a file or a regulation's number: whatever holds a slash.
  /[A-Za-z0-9_.()-]*[/][A-Za-z0-9_./-]+/g,
  // A sub-project's name (3f, 3d, 1b) and a phone check (P1 to P8).
  /(^|[^0-9A-Za-z])([0-9][a-f]|P[1-8])(?=[^0-9A-Za-z]|$)/gm,

  // A finding of the research, with its questions; a row of the design's section 2, and the section itself.
  /(?:OL|AU) E[0-9]+[.][0-9]+(?: questions [0-9]+ to [0-9]+)?/g,
  /[(]rows? [0-9]+(?: and [0-9]+)?[)]/g,
  /section [0-9]+/g,
  // A step of a list named in a sentence.
  /steps? [0-9]+/g,
  // An instant as an example of the form, a date of the year, the hand-over's user, a hash's name, a status's code.
  /[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:]+Z/g,
  /[0-9]+ March/g,
  /uid [0-9]+/g,
  /sha256/g,
  /answers 503/g,
];

describe("the README's authorities' orders say what the constants say (3f design, section 13, Task 7; W.9 and W.10)", () => {
  test("the README has the section Authorities' orders after Moderation, and each of its parts stands there once, in W.9's order", () => {
    const lines = readmeLines();
    expect(lines.indexOf(ORDERS_HEADING)).toBeGreaterThan(lines.indexOf("## Moderation"));
    const section = sectionLines(ORDERS_HEADING).map(withoutCodeMarks);
    const at = ORDERS_TITLES.map((title) => section.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith(`**${title}`)));
    for (const title of ORDERS_TITLES) expect(section.filter((line) => line.startsWith(`**${title}`)), title).toHaveLength(1);
    expect([...at].sort((a, b) => a - b)).toEqual(at);
  });

  test("Before going public holds the owner's list of thirteen, each line by its title, in W.10's order", () => {
    const owners = linesFrom(sectionLines("## Before going public"), OWNERS_LEAD, "Set these in").filter((line) => /^[0-9]+[.] /.test(line));
    expect(owners.map((line) => line.slice(0, line.indexOf(" ")))).toEqual(OWNERS_TITLES.map((_, n) => `${n + 1}.`));
    for (const [n, title] of OWNERS_TITLES.entries()) expect(owners[n]!.startsWith(`${n + 1}. **${title}`), title).toBe(true);
  });

  test("every number of 3f's text stands in its sentence with the constant's value", () => {
    const parts = ordersParts();
    for (const row of ORDER_NUMBERS) expect(parts[row.part], `${row.constant}: ${row.phrase}`).toContain(row.phrase);
  });

  test("and no other number: every run of digits in it is a constant's, outside what names a reference", () => {
    const values = new Set<string>([...Object.values(O), ...Object.values(A)].filter((value) => typeof value === "number").map(String));
    const outside = REFERENCES.reduce((text, pattern) => text.replace(pattern, (_match: string, lead: unknown) => (typeof lead === "string" ? `${lead} ` : " ")), ordersText());
    expect((outside.match(/[0-9]+/g) ?? []).filter((digits) => !values.has(digits))).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a setting is written as the operator sets it in infra/.env: an API setting with its prefix", () => {
    const withMarks = [sectionLines(ORDERS_HEADING), linesFrom(sectionLines("## Upgrading"), "Authorities' orders and the alert channel"), linesFrom(sectionLines("## Restoring"), "**Restoring with the keeper's copy**")]
      .flatMap((lines) => withoutFences(lines))
      .join("\n");
    for (const name of ["NOTIFY", "REPORT_HOLD", "MODERATION_RETENTION", "HOME_STATE", "CONTACT_POINT", "PUSH_ORIGIN", "APP_ORIGIN"]) {
      expect(withMarks.includes(`${CODE_MARK}${name}`), name).toBe(false);
    }
    for (const name of ["API_CONTACT_POINT", "API_HOME_STATE", "API_REPORT_HOLD", "API_MODERATION_RETENTION", "APP_SITE", "COMPOSE_PROFILES", "WEB_CONTACT_POINT", "WEB_HOME_STATE"]) {
      expect(withMarks.includes(name) || ordersText().includes(name), name).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  test("the hand-over's and the yearly counts' commands stand in the runbook as the operator types them", () => {
    const orders = ordersParts().orders;
    for (const words of [
      "docker compose --profile handover run --rm -T -v <directory>:/handover handover < list > digests",
      "handover-list",
      "handover-record",
      "handover-destroyed",
      "staff.js tco-counts <last year>",
      "docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm -T migrate node dist/staff.js address-check --handle <handle> < address",
    ]) {
      expect(orders, words).toContain(words);
    }
    expect(readmeLines().join("\n")).toContain("docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm migrate node dist/staff.js tco-counts <year>");
  });

  test("3f's review: a sentence of Restoring or of the orders' runbook that sets APP_SITE recreates Caddy alone, and one that sets an API switch names the start that reads it", () => {
    // Caddy reads APP_SITE only when its container is created, and the API reads its switches only at its start: a
    // setting in infra/.env alone changes nothing. Without --no-deps Compose would start the API with Caddy.
    const sentences = [...sectionLines("## Restoring"), ...sectionLines(ORDERS_HEADING)].flatMap((line) => line.split(/(?<=[.;])\s+(?=[A-Z`(])/));
    const site = sentences.filter((sentence) => sentence.includes("`APP_SITE="));
    const api = sentences.filter((sentence) => /`API_[A-Z_]+=/.test(sentence));
    expect(site.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
    expect(api.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
    for (const sentence of site) expect(sentence, sentence).toContain("up -d --no-deps caddy");
    for (const sentence of api) expect(sentence, sentence).toContain("up -d api");
    // operations5: a message moved between the two folders is a second row; the runbook says not to, and what then.
    expect(ordersParts().orders).toContain("Never move a message between the inbox and the junk folder");
    expect(ordersParts().orders).toContain("close the second row on Contact point with the first row's word");
  });

  test("the lines 3f made false are gone, and the hard gate reads as W.10 words it", () => {
    const all = readmeLines().join("\n");
    expect(all).not.toContain("Until sub-project 3f's off-server copy of decisions");

    expect(all).not.toContain("staff.js account-facts");
    expect(all).not.toContain("account-facts <handle>");
    expect(all).not.toContain("Authorities' orders before 3f.");
    expect(all).not.toContain("in their own records until sub-project 3f");
    expect(all).not.toContain("With sub-project 3f the authorities' contact address is published as well");
    // 3d Task 2 (W.11): the gate's first line reads 3d's quarantine and release.
    expect(all).toContain("until sub-project 3f's order path and sub-project 3d's quarantine and release have shipped and the list below is done");
  });
});
