```ts
    expect(await countKeys()).toEqual([]);
    const broken = new Redis("redis://127.0.0.1:1/0", { maxRetriesPerRequest: 0, lazyConnect: true, enableOfflineQueue: false, retryStrategy: () => null });
    broken.on("error", () => undefined);
    const auth = createAuth({ config, logger, authDb, kv: new MemoryKv(), mailer: new MemoryMailer(), profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb) });
    const failing = createTransparency({ apiDb, redis: broken, auth: auth.forTransparency, config, logger, now: () => clock });
    auth.onSeen(failing.forAuth);
    const failingApp = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(), healthChecks: {}, auth, social: createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(), logger, requireSession: auth.requireSession, requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth() }), transparency: failing });
    const res = await failingApp.request("/api/timeline/latest");
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    await settle();
    broken.disconnect();
  });

  test("the job's round closes the month before: two numbers stored, the month's keys deleted; once a day after the dispatch hour it publishes what edition is due", async () => {
    await removeKeys();
    await removeMonths();
    // April 2009: two accounts seen, one reader on two days.
    const accounts = ["a1b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1", "a1b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a2"];
    clock = new Date("2009-04-03T09:00:00.000Z");
    for (const account of accounts) transparency.forAuth.seen(account);
    transparency.forAuth.seenSignedOut("203.0.113.9", "Mozilla/5.0 Firefox/140.0", "/api/timeline/latest");
    clock = new Date("2009-04-04T09:00:00.000Z");
    transparency.forAuth.seenSignedOut("203.0.113.9", "Mozilla/5.0 Firefox/140.0", "/api/timeline/latest");
    await settle();
    expect(await countKeys()).toEqual(["mau:in:2009-04", "mau:out:2009-04-03", "mau:out:2009-04-04", "mau:salt:2009-04-03", "mau:salt:2009-04-04"]);

    // The first of May, before the dispatch hour: the month closes; no edition is asked for yet.
    clock = new Date(Date.UTC(2009, 4, 1, config.MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR - 1, 30));
    try {
      const first = await transparency.round();
      expect(first).toEqual({ months: ["2009-04"], editions: null, head: null });
      const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<{ month: string; signed_in: number; signed_out_days: number; method: number; fresh: boolean }>(
        sql`select month::text, signed_in, signed_out_days, method, computed_at > now() - interval '1 minute' as fresh from public.recipient_months where month = '2009-04-01'::date`,
      );
      expect({ ...row }).toEqual({ month: "2009-04-01", signed_in: 2, signed_out_days: 2, method: RECIPIENT_RULES.method, fresh: true });
      expect((await countKeys()).filter((key) => !key.startsWith("mau:salt:"))).toEqual([]);
      expect(await redis.exists(sketchKeys.month("2009-04"))).toBe(0);

      // After the dispatch hour: the last closed year's edition (2008) is due and published once, by the API's role.
      clock = new Date(Date.UTC(2009, 4, 1, config.MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR, 5));
      const second = await transparency.round();
      // 3d Task 5: the same daily pass publishes the head's value of the database's today, which writes no audit row.
      expect(second).toMatchObject({ months: [], editions: [{ year: YEAR, version: 1 }], head: { inserted: true, published: true } });
      const [audit] = await migrateDb.execute<{ action: string; target_id: string }>(sql`select action, target_id from public.audit_log where chain_seq = (select seq from public.audit_head where id = 1)`);
      expect({ ...audit }).toEqual({ action: "edition_published", target_id: `${YEAR}.1` });
      // Later the same day: nothing more. The next day: asked again, and nothing new is written.
      clock = new Date(Date.UTC(2009, 4, 1, 23, 0));
      expect(await transparency.round()).toEqual({ months: [], editions: null, head: null });
      clock = new Date(Date.UTC(2009, 4, 2, config.MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR, 5));
      expect(await transparency.round()).toMatchObject({ months: [], editions: [], head: { inserted: false, published: false } });
    } finally {
      clock = new Date("2009-05-17T10:00:00.000Z");
      await removeYear(YEAR);
      await removeMonths();
      await removeKeys();
      await removeHead();
    }
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";

import { noticeTime } from "../../src/auth/flows/notify";

import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { TICK_MAILED_KINDS } from "../../src/moderation/alerts";
import { ACCOUNT_DELETED_HELD, DECISION_MAIL_SUBJECTS, renderMail, renderNoticeUpdate, renderTemplate } from "../../src/mail/templates";
import { IMAGE_LOST_NOTICE, RELEASE_NOTICE, releaseNoticeParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";

/**
 * The mails of deciding and of the dispatch (3c design, section 7.15): the author's statement, the staff alerts for a
 * burst of decisions, for a decision that lifted the protection of reported images and for cases that wait too long, and
 * the one structured mail, the daily update of decisions on a person's reports. Each is pinned word for word.
 */
const LAST_USER = "korbat staff never ask for your password or a code, and korbat does not read replies to this email.";
const LAST_STAFF = "korbat never puts a link in a staff email.";
const paragraphs = (text: string) => text.trimEnd().split("\n\n");
const TIME = "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC";

/** No link of any kind, and the staff mails' last sentence. */
function linkless(r: { text: string; html: string }) {
  expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|:[/][/]/);
  expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=|https?:/);
  expect(paragraphs(r.text).at(-1)).toBe(LAST_STAFF);
}

describe("notice_update: decisions on a person's reports, once a day", () => {
  const POST = "http://localhost:8081/post/0190f3a2-7c1e-7b1a-9f00-0123456789ab";
  const PAGE = "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ABCDEFGH23#t=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA";
  const TERMS = "http://localhost:8081/terms";
  const COURTS = "go to court, or complain to the Digital Services Coordinator of the EU country where you live (Article 53 of the Digital Services Act).";
  const REEXAMINE = "You can ask korbat once, within six months and free of charge, to re-examine a moderator's decision to take no action: it is decided again as a new report.";
  const FINAL = "A decision changed on review or by a correction, or given on re-examination, is final within korbat.";
  const line = (more: Partial<NoticeUpdateLine> = {}): NoticeUpdateLine => ({
    ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23",
    item: 1,
    link: POST,
    outcome: outcomeWords({ outcome: "restricted_legal", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null }),
    reexamination: false,
    changed: false,
    reexaminable: false,
    unseen: false,
    automatic: false,
    ...more,
  });
  const noAction = outcomeWords({ outcome: "no_violation", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null });
  const update = (more: Partial<NoticeUpdateData>): NoticeUpdateData => ({ signedIn: false, lines: [], receipts: [], pages: [], ...more });

  test("signed out: one paragraph per line, the page of each notice it has a line for, that nothing was automated, and the courts", () => {
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line(), line({ item: 2, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada" })], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(r.subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.`,
      "N-ABCDEFGH23, item 2 (http://localhost:8081/u/ada): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.",
      `To see report N-ABCDEFGH23 or ask for a re-examination of a decision on it, open this page: ${PAGE}`,
      "No automated means were used to decide.",
      `You can ${COURTS}`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    // The page link stands at the end of its paragraph, and nothing is an anchor.
    expect(r.text).toMatch(/#t=A{43}$/m);
    expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=/);
  });

  test("signed in: no page link, and the re-examination points to Your reports", () => {
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ signedIn: true, lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.`,
      "No automated means were used to decide.",
      `${REEXAMINE} Use korbat's Settings, Cases, Your reports.`,
      `You can also ${COURTS}`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[/]notice[/]|#t=/);
    // A signed-in update never carries a page or a receipt: handed either, it is refused rather than mailed.
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({ signedIn: true, lines: [line()], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }))).toThrow(/signed-in/);
  });

  test("the re-examination sentence goes only with a re-examinable line, and points to the page when signed out", () => {
    const withIt = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true })], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(paragraphs(withIt.text)).toContain(`${REEXAMINE} Use the page linked in this email for that report.`);
    expect(paragraphs(withIt.text)).toContain(`You can also ${COURTS}`);
    const without = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line()] }));
    expect(without.text).not.toContain("re-examine a moderator's decision");
    expect(paragraphs(without.text)).toContain(`You can ${COURTS}`);
  });

  test("a re-examination's answer and a changed outcome are final within korbat; a line that reads UNSEEN_NO_ACTION never is, re-examined again or not", () => {
    const answered = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexamination: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(answered.text)[0]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}), re-examined: no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.`);
    expect(paragraphs(answered.text)).toContain(FINAL);
    expect(answered.text).not.toContain("re-examine a moderator's decision");
    const changed = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: "korbat reversed its decision to restrict it.", changed: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(changed.text)).toContain(FINAL);
    // An answer given while nobody could open the images does not spend the re-examination, also when it answered one.
    const unseenLine = { outcome: UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, unseen: true };
    const open = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ ...unseenLine, reexamination: true, reexaminable: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(open.text)[0]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}), re-examined: ${UNSEEN_NO_ACTION}`);
    expect(open.text).not.toContain(FINAL);
    expect(open.text).toContain(REEXAMINE);
    // Asked again before a retried mail went out: no longer re-examinable, and still not final.
    const asked = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ ...unseenLine, reexamination: true, reexaminable: false })] }));
    expect(asked.text).not.toContain(FINAL);
    expect(asked.text).not.toContain(REEXAMINE);
    // A line of each kind in one update: each sentence once.
    const both = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true }), line({ item: 2, outcome: noAction, reexamination: true })] }));
    expect(both.text.split(FINAL).length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(both.text.split(REEXAMINE).length - 1).toBe(1);
  });

  test("only a link that named nothing is called automatic", () => {
    const dead = outcomeWords({ outcome: "not_available", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null });
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line(), line({ item: 2, outcome: dead, automatic: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toContain("No automated means were used to decide, except for links found to name nothing on korbat, which were checked automatically.");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toContain("If a link was wrong, send a new report with the right link.");
    const live = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line()] }));
    expect(paragraphs(live.text)).toContain("No automated means were used to decide.");
    expect(live.text).not.toContain("If a link was wrong");
  });

  test("the outcome's words are the contracts': ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, the scopes, the sealed phrase and UNSEEN_NO_ACTION stand in a line exactly as composed, with one full stop", () => {
    const facts = { rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null } as const;
    const outcomes = [
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "restricted_legal", noEffect: true }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", scope: "account" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "restricted_legal", sealed: true, scope: "account_suspect" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", scope: "quote" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", unseen: true }),
    ];
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: outcomes.map((outcome, index) => line({ item: index + 1, outcome })) }));
    const lines = paragraphs(r.text).slice(0, outcomes.length);
    outcomes.forEach((outcome, index) => expect(lines[index]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item ${index + 1} (${POST}): ${outcome}`));
    for (const sentence of [ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE, ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE, QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE, SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed, UNSEEN_NO_ACTION]) expect(r.text).toContain(sentence);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[.][.]/);
  });

  test("a folded receipt rides in the update with its page link; an update of receipts alone has another subject and none of the decisions' sentences", () => {
    const receipt = { ref: "N-ZZZZZZZZ77", time: TIME, items: POST, pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ZZZZZZZZ77#t=BBBB" };
    const alone = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt], termsUrl: TERMS }));
    expect(alone.subject).toBe("korbat received your reports");
    expect(paragraphs(alone.text)).toEqual([
      `korbat received your report N-ZZZZZZZZ77 at ${TIME}. It names: ${POST}.`,
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a re-examination of a decision, confirm that you sent it, or stop korbat's emails about reports to this address, open this page: http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ZZZZZZZZ77#t=BBBB",
      `How korbat handles reports, and what it keeps: ${TERMS}.`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    // Two folds on one day and a line of another notice: the receipts first, the terms once, then the line and its page.
    const second = { ...receipt, ref: "N-YYYYYYYY66", pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-YYYYYYYY66#t=CCCC" };
    const full = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt, second], termsUrl: TERMS, lines: [line()], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(full.subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    const out = paragraphs(full.text);
    expect(out.slice(0, 5).map((paragraph) => paragraph.slice(0, 42))).toEqual([
      "korbat received your report N-ZZZZZZZZ77 a",
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a",
      "korbat received your report N-YYYYYYYY66 a",
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a",
      "How korbat handles reports, and what it ke",
    ]);
    expect(full.text.split("How korbat handles reports").length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(out[5]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.`);
    expect(out[6]).toBe(`To see report N-ABCDEFGH23 or ask for a re-examination of a decision on it, open this page: ${PAGE}`);
    // A receipt needs the terms' address, and an update of nothing at all is a programming error.
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt] }))).toThrow(/termsUrl/);
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({}))).toThrow(/nothing/);
  });

  test("it carries only what korbat generated: no member of the data holds a report's words", () => {
    const keys = Object.keys(line()).sort();
    expect(keys).toEqual(["automatic", "changed", "item", "link", "outcome", "reexaminable", "reexamination", "ref", "unseen"]);
  });
});

describe("the mailers take the union of messages", () => {
  test("the memory mailer renders a flat message with renderTemplate and the structured one with renderNoticeUpdate, keeps the two apart, and reads a code only from a flat message", async () => {
    const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
    const structured: MailMessage = { to: "a@b.io", template: "notice_update", data: { signedIn: true, lines: [], receipts: [], pages: [] } };
    // An update of nothing is refused as the real mailer would refuse it, before it counts as sent.
    await expect(mailer.send(structured)).rejects.toThrow(/nothing/);
    expect([mailer.sent.length, mailer.updates.length]).toEqual([0, 0]);
    await mailer.send({ to: "a@b.io", template: "sign_in_code", data: { code: "111111" } });
    await mailer.send({
      to: "a@b.io",
      template: "notice_update",
      data: { signedIn: true, lines: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", item: 1, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada", outcome: "no action.", reexamination: false, changed: false, reexaminable: false, unseen: false, automatic: false }], receipts: [], pages: [] },
    });
    // The two kinds are kept apart, so a reader of the flat ones never meets a structure.
    expect(mailer.sent.map((message) => message.template)).toEqual(["sign_in_code"]);
    expect(mailer.updates.map((message) => message.template)).toEqual(["notice_update"]);
    expect(mailer.lastCodeFor("a@b.io")).toBe("111111");
    expect(renderMail(mailer.updates[0]!).subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    expect(renderMail(mailer.sent[0]!).subject).toBe("Your korbat sign-in code");
  });

  test("a time in a mail is printed as noticeTime prints it", () => {
    expect(noticeTime(new Date("2026-10-04T06:59:59.999Z"))).toBe(TIME);
  });
});

describe("3e: the statement mails of a suspension taken at once and of its lift (design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6)", () => {
  const lines = ["korbat suspended your account for 7 days, from this decision until 2026-10-11 09:30 UTC, without notice beforehand.", "The facts: The account posted a threat."];
  const statement = lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
  const READ = "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.";

  test("suspension_started_at_once: its subject, its lead with the days and the end, the statement's paragraphs, where to read it, and no link", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", days: "7", endsAt: "2026-10-11 09:30 UTC", statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat suspended your account");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat suspended your korbat account for 7 days, until 2026-10-11 09:30 UTC. It did so at once, without notice beforehand; the reasons follow. You can reply and appeal in korbat from now: sign in and use the banner on any screen.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]/);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", days: "1", endsAt: "2026-10-05 09:30 UTC", statement }).text)[0]).toContain("for 1 day, until");
    // A termination's lead names no days and no end.
    const t = renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "terminate", statement });
    expect(t.subject).toBe("korbat terminated your account");
    expect(paragraphs(t.text)[0]).toBe("korbat terminated your korbat account. It did so at once, without notice beforehand; the reasons follow. You can reply and appeal in korbat from now: sign in and use the banner on any screen.");
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", statement })).toThrow(/days/);
  });

  test("suspension_lifted: a lead for each state of the period, for a lift and for a basis that broke, and none says the account is free of every measure", () => {
    const lead = (why: string, period: string) => {
      const r = renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why, period, statement });
      expect(paragraphs(r.text).slice(1)).toEqual([...lines, READ, LAST_USER]);
      return [r.subject, paragraphs(r.text)[0]];
    };
    expect(lead("lifted", "not_started")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted the suspension of your korbat account that it had announced: it never starts."]);
    expect(lead("lifted", "running")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted the suspension of your korbat account. This suspension no longer restricts your account."]);
    expect(lead("lifted", "ended")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted a past suspension of your korbat account: it no longer counts toward a later suspension."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "not_started")).toEqual(["A suspension of your account will not start", "korbat reversed a decision that the suspension it announced for your korbat account rested on. The suspension will not start."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "running")).toEqual(["A suspension of your account has ended", "The suspension of your korbat account has ended, because a decision it rested on was reversed. This suspension no longer restricts your account."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "ended")).toEqual(["A past suspension of your account no longer counts", "korbat reversed a decision that a past suspension of your account rested on; that suspension no longer counts."]);
    for (const why of ["lifted", "basis"]) {
      for (const period of ["not_started", "running", "ended"]) expect(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why, period, statement }).text).not.toMatch(/as before|handed to your mail provider|delivered/);
    }
    expect(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "terminate", why: "lifted", period: "running", statement }).subject).toBe("korbat lifted the termination of your account");
    // Task 4: a withdrawal needs the withdrawn decision's time; a why the template does not have is a programming error.
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "replaced", period: "running", statement })).toThrow(/decidedAt/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "answered", period: "running", statement })).toThrow(/why/);
  });
});

describe("3e Task 4: the mails of an announced measure, of the answer to a reply, of a withdrawal, and of a termination's take-down (design, section 18, W.6)", () => {
  const lines = ["korbat will suspend your account for 3 days. Nothing is restricted yet.", "The facts: The account had 3 active strikes."];
  const statement = lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
  const READ = "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.";
  const EARLIEST = "2026-10-11 09:30 UTC";

  test("suspension_announced: its subject, its lead with the days, the window and the earliest start, the reply, then the statement; a termination's without days", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "3", window: String(STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours), earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat has decided to suspend your account: you can reply first");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `korbat has decided to suspend your korbat account for 3 days. Nothing is restricted yet. The suspension starts ${STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours} hours after korbat sent this email, and not before ${EARLIEST}.`,
      `You can reply before it starts: sign in to korbat, where this decision is always shown and a banner on every screen gives the exact time and a Reply button. A reply sent before ${EARLIEST} is certainly in time, and holds the start until a moderator has answered you.`,
      "The decision and its reasons follow.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|handed to your mail provider|delivered/);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "1", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement }).text)[0]).toContain("for 1 day.");
    const t = renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "terminate", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement });
    expect(t.subject).toBe("korbat has decided to terminate your account: you can reply first");
    expect(paragraphs(t.text)[0]).toBe(`korbat has decided to terminate your korbat account. Nothing is restricted yet. The termination starts 168 hours after korbat sent this email, and not before ${EARLIEST}.`);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement })).toThrow(/days/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "3", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement })).toThrow(/window/);
  });

  test("reply_answered: a lead for a kept and for a reversed answer, then the answer's statement", () => {
    const kept = renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "kept", statement });
    expect(kept.subject).toBe("korbat answered your reply");
    expect(paragraphs(kept.text)).toEqual(["A moderator read your reply and kept the decision. The answer and its reasons follow.", ...lines, READ, LAST_USER]);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "reversed", statement }).text)[0]).toBe("A moderator read your reply and reversed the decision. The answer follows.");
    expect(() => renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "withdrawn", statement })).toThrow(/outcome/);
  });

  test("suspension_lifted for a withdrawal: never an answer to the reply, and the sentence on the reply only when one was filed", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "replaced", decidedAt: "2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", replied: "true", statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat withdrew the suspension it announced");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat withdrew the suspension of your korbat account that it announced on 2026-10-04 09:30 UTC, because it is taking another measure on your account. This is not a decision on your reply.",
      "The decision about the other measure reaches you separately.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "terminate", why: "replaced", decidedAt: "2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", replied: "false", statement }).text)[0]).toBe(
      "korbat withdrew the termination of your korbat account that it announced on 2026-10-04 09:30 UTC, because it is taking another measure on your account.",
    );
  });

  test("termination_final: the decision's day, that it is final, what is deleted, the sentence on sealed images only when images are sealed, and never that korbat keeps nothing when they are", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "false" });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat has closed your terminated account");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat's decision of 2026-04-04 09:30 UTC to terminate your korbat account is final: the time to appeal has passed, or your appeal was answered and the decision kept, and no reply of yours is unanswered.",
      "korbat has closed the account and is now deleting its posts and profile and every image it has not sealed, as that decision said. This cannot be undone. The handle stays reserved, so nobody else can take it.",
      "korbat keeps nothing to recognise a new account of yours by. A new account that carries on what this one was terminated for breaks korbat's terms.",
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    const sealed = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "true" });
    expect(paragraphs(sealed.text)[2]).toBe(
      "korbat keeps nothing to recognise a new account of yours by. Images of yours that korbat sealed stay with it for the authorities alone, as the decision that sealed them said. A new account that carries on what this one was terminated for breaks korbat's terms.",
    );
    for (const mail of [r, sealed]) expect(mail.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|@[a-z]/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("termination_final", { imagesSealed: "false" })).toThrow(/decided/);
    // 3f (7.15 step 8): a termination's take-down holds the address as a deletion does, and its mail says so the same way.
    const held = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "true", heldUntil: "2026-04-11", holdFinal: "true" });
    expect(paragraphs(held.text)[3]).toBe(ACCOUNT_DELETED_HELD.final("2026-04-11"));
    expect(paragraphs(held.text).at(-1)).toBe(LAST_USER);
  });
});

describe("3f: the staff mails whose words are their push's (W.4)", () => {
  const NOW = "2026-10-16T09:00:00.000Z";
  /** A kind's mail as the alert tick sends it: the row's facts as text, and the time it is sent, for the day of its times. */
  const mail = (template: TemplateName, facts: Record<string, string>) => renderTemplate(template as Parameters<typeof renderTemplate>[0], { ...facts, now: NOW });

  test("each is the kind's title after korbat:, then its sentence and its line of what to do from ALERT_TEXTS, and the staff mails' last sentence", () => {
    const cases: [TemplateName, AlertKind, Record<string, string>][] = [
      ["contact_mail", "contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }],
      ["contact_mail_escalated", "contact_mail_escalated", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }],
      ["order_due", "order_due", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", minutesLeft: "15" }],
      ["mailbox_unreachable", "mailbox_unreachable", { since: "2026-10-15T23:00:00.000Z" }],
      ["alert_channel_down", "alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z" }],
      // Task 2: an order opened (with a deadline, and without a time of receipt), a record corrected, the daily unverified.
      ["order_opened", "order_opened", { items: "2", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", unknown: "0" }],
      ["order_opened", "order_opened", { items: "1", unknown: "1" }],
      ["order_corrected", "order_corrected", { count: "2", at: "2026-10-16T08:50:00.000Z" }],
      ["order_unverified", "order_unverified", { count: "1", textsMissing: "1", holdsOpen: "0", oldestAt: "2026-10-15T22:00:00.000Z" }],
    ];
    for (const [template, kind, facts] of cases) {
      const r = mail(template, facts);
      const counted = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(facts).map(([name, value]) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? value : Number(value)]));
      const text = renderAlert(kind, counted, new Date(NOW));
      expect(r.subject, template).toBe(`korbat: ${text.title}`);
      expect(paragraphs(r.text), template).toEqual([text.sentence, text.todo, LAST_STAFF]);
      linkless(r);
    }
    expect(paragraphs(mail("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }).text)[0]).toBe(
      "Mail at the authorities' contact point, received 08:05 UTC. If it is a removal order it is due 09:05 UTC.",
    );
    expect(mail("order_due", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", minutesLeft: "0" }).subject).toBe("korbat: 0 minutes left");
  });

  test("3f's review: every kind whose mail is its sentence is one the alert tick mails, and each has its template: Task 5's two daily kinds too", () => {
    expect([...TICK_MAILED_KINDS].sort()).toEqual([...SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS].sort());
    for (const kind of SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS) {
      const facts = Object.fromEntries(ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts.map((name) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" : "2"]));
      const r = mail(kind as TemplateName, facts);
      expect(r.subject, kind).toBe(`korbat: ${renderAlert(kind, Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(facts).map(([n, v]) => [n, isTimeFact(n) ? v : Number(v)])), new Date(NOW)).title}`);
      linkless(r);
    }
  });

  test("they carry counts and UTC times only: a fact of another name, a time that is no time and a missing one are refused, and no handle or address is printed", () => {
    expect(() => mail("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z" })).toThrow(/dueAt/);
    expect(() => mail("mailbox_unreachable", { since: "yesterday" })).toThrow(/since/);
    expect(() => mail("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z", handle: "mod_anna" })).toThrow(/handle/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z" })).toThrow(/now/);
    for (const template of ["contact_mail", "contact_mail_escalated", "order_due", "mailbox_unreachable", "alert_channel_down", "order_opened", "order_corrected", "order_unverified"] as const) {
      const facts = Object.fromEntries(ALERT_KINDS[template].facts.map((name) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" : "3"]));
      expect(mail(template, facts).text, template).not.toMatch(/@/);
    }
  });
});

describe("3d Task 2: the release's two staff mails and the author's notice (W.6, W.7, W.8)", () => {
  const NOW = "2026-10-18T12:00:00.000Z";

  test("seal_released and release_undestroyed are their pushes' sentences with the line of what to do, counts and times only", () => {
    const released = renderTemplate("seal_released", { at: "2026-10-18T11:40:00.000Z", posts: "2", uploads: "0", now: NOW });
    expect(released.subject).toBe("korbat: An admin released sealed images");
    expect(paragraphs(released.text).slice(0, 2)).toEqual([
      "An admin released sealed images at 11:40 UTC: 2 posts, 0 held uploads. The files are to be destroyed.",
      "This cannot be taken back. Every staff account gets this mail, the admin who did it too. If you did not expect it, look at the case now and tell the operator: until the files are destroyed and the backups have aged out, a release that should not have happened can still be met by keeping them.",
```

```ts
  return made;
}

/** A store in memory that owes the given rows and records what the round did with them. */
function owing(rows: OwedPush[]) {
  const owed = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r]));
  const attempts = new Map<number, number>();
  const beats: { mailboxOk: boolean; pushOk: boolean; error: string | null }[] = [];
  const store: NotifyStore = {
    folderMark: async () => null,
    insertMessage: async () => undefined,
    setMark: async () => undefined,
    owedPushes: async () => [...owed.values()].sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id),
    markPushed: async (id) => {
      owed.delete(id);
    },
    markFailed: async (id) => {
      attempts.set(id, (attempts.get(id) ?? 0) + 1);
    },
    beat: async (state) => {
      beats.push(state);
    },
  };
  return { store, owed, attempts, beats };
}

describe("the round's publish step", () => {
  /** A watcher whose mailbox cannot be reached at all, so a round is its publish step and its beat. */
  const watcher = (s: FakeNtfy, store: NotifyStore, now = () => NOW) =>
    createWatcher({
      store,
      imap: { host: "localhost", port: 9, user: "watcher", password: "secret", junk: "Junk", timeoutMs: 500 },
      push: { url: s.url, token: "tk_publisher" },
      fetch,
      now,
      log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    });

    const w = watcher(s, m.store);
    const report = await w.round();
    expect(report).toMatchObject({ pushed: 2, pushOk: true, error: "imap_connect" });
    expect(s.published.map((p) => p.tags)).toEqual(["contact_mail", "moderation_urgent"]);
    expect(s.published.every((p) => p.token === "tk_publisher")).toBe(true);
    expect(m.owed.size).toBe(0);
    expect(m.beats).toEqual([{ mailboxOk: false, pushOk: true, error: "imap_connect" }]);
    await w.stop();
  });

  test("a refused row counts an attempt, sets push_refused and stays owed; the next row is still tried; nothing owed reads as a working push", async () => {
    const s = await ntfy();

    expect(m.beats.at(-1)).toEqual({ mailboxOk: false, pushOk: false, error: "push_refused" });
    // No cap: the next round tries it again, and it goes.
    expect(await w.round()).toMatchObject({ pushed: 1, pushOk: true });
    expect(m.owed.size).toBe(0);
    expect(await w.round()).toMatchObject({ pushed: 0, pushOk: true });
    await w.stop();
  });

    let clock = NOW.getTime();

  };
```

```ts
import { createHmac } from "node:crypto";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { Hono } from "hono";
import { createMiddleware } from "hono/factory";
import pino from "pino";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { PublicFacts, RECIPIENT_RULES, type TransparencyFigures } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { clientNetwork } from "../../src/auth";
import type { AuthDeps } from "../../src/auth/context";
import { resolveSession } from "../../src/auth/middleware";
import type { AppEnv } from "../../src/env";
import { publicTransparency, type TransparencyForAuth } from "../../src/transparency";
import { closeMonths, createRecipientCounter, isReadRoute, sketchKeys, type SketchStore } from "../../src/transparency/recipients";
import type { EditionRow } from "../../src/transparency/repo";
import { publicFacts } from "../../src/transparency/routes";

/**
 * The recipients' count and the public answers without a database (3d design, sections 5, 7.5, 7.6 and 10.6; Task 4;
 * invariants 22 and 23): what resolveSession hands the count, and only there; what the count writes to Valkey, a store
 * that keeps sets here, and nothing else; the month's close; the facts of a server with every tool off; and the shape of
 * the editions' answer. The same against the real Valkey and database is transparency-public.test.ts's.
 */

/** A store that keeps each sketch as the set of what was added, the salt as bytes, and every expiry asked for. */
function memoryStore() {
  const sketches = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const values = new Map<string, Buffer>();
  const expiries = new Map<string, number>();
  const calls: string[] = [];
  const store = {
    async pfadd(key: string, ...elements: string[]) {
      calls.push(`pfadd ${key}`);
      const set = sketches.get(key) ?? new Set<string>();
      const before = set.size;
      for (const element of elements) set.add(String(element));
      sketches.set(key, set);
      return set.size > before ? 1 : 0;
    },
    async pfcount(...keys: string[]) {
      return new Set(keys.flatMap((key) => [...(sketches.get(key) ?? [])])).size;
    },
    async expire(key: string, seconds: number, mode: string) {
      calls.push(`expire ${key} ${seconds} ${mode}`);
      if (mode === "NX" && expiries.has(key)) return 0;
      expiries.set(key, seconds);
      return 1;
    },
    async set(key: string, value: Buffer, ex: string, seconds: number, nx: string) {
      calls.push(`set ${key} ${ex} ${seconds} ${nx}`);
      if (nx === "NX" && values.has(key)) return null;
      values.set(key, value);
      expiries.set(key, seconds);
      return "OK";
    },
    async getBuffer(key: string) {
      return values.get(key) ?? null;
    },
    async exists(...keys: string[]) {
      return keys.filter((key) => sketches.has(key) || values.has(key)).length;
    },
    async del(...keys: string[]) {
      let n = 0;
      for (const key of keys) if (sketches.delete(key) || values.delete(key)) n++;
      return n;
    },
  };
  return { store: store as unknown as SketchStore, sketches, values, expiries, calls };
}

      },
    };
    expect((await app(throwing).request("/api/timeline/latest")).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await app(throwing).request("/api/timeline/latest", { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${GOOD}` } })).status).toBe(200);
  });

  test("seen adds the account to the UTC month's sketch, which lives 70 days from its first write", async () => {
    const m = memoryStore();
    const count = createRecipientCounter({ store: m.store, signedOut: true, log, now: () => AT });
    count.seen("account-1");
    count.seen("account-1");
    count.seen("account-2");
    await settle();
    expect([...m.sketches.keys()]).toEqual(["mau:in:2014-05"]);
    expect(m.sketches.get("mau:in:2014-05")!.size).toBe(2);
    expect(m.expiries.get("mau:in:2014-05")).toBe(RECIPIENT_RULES.sketchDays * 86_400);
    expect(m.calls.filter((call) => call.startsWith("expire")).every((call) => call.endsWith(" NX"))).toBe(true);
  });

  test("seenSignedOut adds HMAC-SHA-256(the day's salt, network LF agent cut at 256 bytes) to the day's sketch, and nothing else is kept", async () => {
    const m = memoryStore();
    const count = createRecipientCounter({ store: m.store, signedOut: true, log, now: () => AT });
    const long = `${FIREFOX}${"x".repeat(400)}`;
    count.seenSignedOut("203.0.113.9", FIREFOX, "/api/posts/3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a");
    // The same reader on another public read, and on another address of the same IPv6 /64, is one value.
    count.seenSignedOut("203.0.113.9", FIREFOX, "/api/profiles/someone/replies");
    count.seenSignedOut("2001:db8:1:2:aaaa::1", long, "/api/timeline/explore");
    count.seenSignedOut("2001:db8:1:2:bbbb::2", `${long}yyyy`, "/api/timeline/latest");
    await settle();
    expect([...m.sketches.keys()]).toEqual(["mau:out:2014-05-17"]);
    expect([...m.values.keys()]).toEqual(["mau:salt:2014-05-17"]);
    const salt = m.values.get("mau:salt:2014-05-17")!;
    expect(salt.length).toBe(32);
    expect(m.expiries.get("mau:salt:2014-05-17")).toBe(RECIPIENT_RULES.saltHours * 3_600);
    const digest = (address: string, agent: string) =>
      createHmac("sha256", salt)
        .update(Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(clientNetwork(address), "utf8"), Buffer.from([10]), Buffer.from(agent, "utf8").subarray(0, RECIPIENT_RULES.userAgentBytes)]))
        .digest("hex");
    expect([...m.sketches.get("mau:out:2014-05-17")!].sort()).toEqual([digest("203.0.113.9", FIREFOX), digest("2001:db8:1:2::", long)].sort());
    // The salt was set once, with SET NX and its 26 hours, and read back: the process keeps it for the day.
    expect(m.calls.filter((call) => call.startsWith("set "))).toEqual([`set mau:salt:2014-05-17 EX ${RECIPIENT_RULES.saltHours * 3_600} NX`]);
  });

  test("seenSignedOut counts none of a crawler that names itself, another path, or anything while RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT is off", async () => {
    const m = memoryStore();
    const on = createRecipientCounter({ store: m.store, signedOut: true, log, now: () => AT });
    on.seenSignedOut("203.0.113.9", "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Googlebot/2.1)", "/api/timeline/latest");
    for (const path of ["/api/media/x/small.webp", "/api/posts/x/status", "/api/health", "/api/me", "/api/timeline/following", "/api/posts/x/explore", "/api/profiles/a/followers"]) on.seenSignedOut("203.0.113.9", FIREFOX, path);
    const off = createRecipientCounter({ store: m.store, signedOut: false, log, now: () => AT });
    off.seenSignedOut("203.0.113.9", FIREFOX, "/api/timeline/latest");
    await settle();
    expect(m.calls).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a store that fails or throws is swallowed: the calls return at once and throw nothing", async () => {
    const failing = new Proxy({}, { get: () => () => Promise.reject(new Error("Valkey is down")) }) as unknown as SketchStore;
    const throwing = new Proxy({}, {
      get: () => () => {
        throw new Error("Valkey is gone");
      },
    }) as unknown as SketchStore;
    for (const store of [failing, throwing]) {
      const count = createRecipientCounter({ store, signedOut: true, log, now: () => AT });
      expect(() => count.seen("account-1")).not.toThrow();
      expect(() => count.seenSignedOut("203.0.113.9", FIREFOX, "/api/timeline/latest")).not.toThrow();
    }
    await settle();
  });

  test("the seven public reads are counted, and their neighbours are not", () => {
    for (const path of ["/api/posts/p1", "/api/posts/p1/thread", "/api/timeline/latest", "/api/timeline/explore", "/api/profiles/h", "/api/profiles/h/posts", "/api/profiles/h/replies"]) {
      expect([path, isReadRoute(path)]).toEqual([path, true]);
    }
    for (const path of ["/api/posts", "/api/posts/p1/status", "/api/posts/p1/like", "/api/profiles/h/follow", "/api/timeline/latest/x", "/api/public/facts"]) {
      expect([path, isReadRoute(path)]).toEqual([path, false]);
    }
  });

  test("source: the count writes nothing to PostgreSQL and logs no salt, digest, address or agent", () => {
    const source = readFileSync(new URL("../../src/transparency/recipients.ts", import.meta.url), "utf8");
    const counter = source.slice(source.indexOf("export function createRecipientCounter"), source.indexOf("const CLOSE_MONTHS"));
    expect(counter).not.toMatch(/repo|apiDb|execute|insert/);
    expect([...counter.matchAll(/log[.][a-z]+[(]([^;]*)[)]/g)].map((m) => m[1])).toEqual(['{ err }, "recipients: a count was not recorded"']);
  });
});

describe("the month's close (3d Task 4)", () => {
  function repoOf(stored: string[]) {
    const rows: { month: string; signedIn: number; signedOutDays: number | null; method: number }[] = [];
    return {
      rows,
      repo: {
        monthStored: async (month: string) => stored.includes(month) || rows.some((row) => row.month === month),
        storeMonth: async (row: (typeof rows)[number]) => {
          rows.push(row);
          return true;
        },
      },
    };
  }

  test("the month before stores the month's sketch's count and the sum of its days' counts, then its keys go", async () => {
    const m = memoryStore();
    const april = new Date("2014-04-10T08:00:00.000Z");
    const count = createRecipientCounter({ store: m.store, signedOut: true, log, now: () => april });
    count.seen("a");
    count.seen("b");
    count.seenSignedOut("203.0.113.9", FIREFOX, "/api/timeline/latest");
    await settle();
    const { repo, rows } = repoOf([]);
    expect(await closeMonths({ store: m.store, repo, signedOut: true }, AT)).toEqual(["2014-04"]);
    expect(rows).toEqual([{ month: "2014-04", signedIn: 2, signedOutDays: 1, method: RECIPIENT_RULES.method }]);
    expect([...m.sketches.keys()]).toEqual([]);
    // Again: nothing to close.
    expect(await closeMonths({ store: m.store, repo, signedOut: true }, AT)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("with RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT off the second number is null; a month without a sketch gets no row; a stored month only loses its keys", async () => {
    const m = memoryStore();
    await m.store.pfadd(sketchKeys.month("2014-03"), "a");
    await m.store.pfadd(sketchKeys.month("2014-04"), "b");
    const { repo, rows } = repoOf(["2014-03"]);
    expect(await closeMonths({ store: m.store, repo, signedOut: false }, AT)).toEqual(["2014-04"]);
    expect(rows).toEqual([{ month: "2014-04", signedIn: 1, signedOutDays: null, method: RECIPIENT_RULES.method }]);
    expect(m.sketches.has(sketchKeys.month("2014-03"))).toBe(false);
    // The running month is never closed.
    await m.store.pfadd(sketchKeys.month("2014-05"), "c");
    expect(await closeMonths({ store: m.store, repo, signedOut: false }, AT)).toEqual([]);
    expect(m.sketches.has(sketchKeys.month("2014-05"))).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("the public answers' shape (3d Task 4)", () => {
  test("the facts of a server with every tool off, the edge as its adapter, and the setting", () => {
    const off = publicFacts({ EDGE_PURGE: "off", RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT: "on", HEAD_WITNESS: "off" });
    expect(PublicFacts.parse(off)).toEqual(off);
    expect([off.r1.state, off.match.state, off.edge, off.witness, off.recipientsSignedOut]).toEqual(["off", "off", { on: false, test: false }, { on: false, test: false }, true]);
    expect(publicFacts({ EDGE_PURGE: "test", RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT: "off", HEAD_WITNESS: "off" })).toMatchObject({ edge: { on: true, test: true }, recipientsSignedOut: false });
    expect(publicFacts({ EDGE_PURGE: "cloudflare", RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT: "on", HEAD_WITNESS: "off" }).edge).toEqual({ on: true, test: false });
    // 3d Task 5: the head's witness prints its adapter, a test one as such.
    expect(publicFacts({ EDGE_PURGE: "off", RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT: "on", HEAD_WITNESS: "rfc3161" }).witness).toEqual({ on: true, test: false });
    expect(publicFacts({ EDGE_PURGE: "off", RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT: "on", HEAD_WITNESS: "test" }).witness).toEqual({ on: true, test: true });
  });

  test("the editions' answer: each year's newest version, newest year first, with its older versions and the day each was replaced", () => {
    const figures = { restrictions: { byGround: [], byMeasure: [], total: "0" }, noBreach: "0", intakes: [], appeals: [], reexaminations: [], accountMeasures: [], automated: { findings: [], measures: [] }, recipients: "not recorded" } as TransparencyFigures;
    const row = (year: number, version: number, at: string, reason: EditionRow["reason"]): EditionRow => ({ year, version, publishedAt: new Date(at), method: 1, reason, figures });
    const answer = publicTransparency([
      row(2014, 3, "2016-01-05T10:00:00Z", "correction"),
      row(2014, 2, "2015-05-02T10:00:00Z", "hold_ended"),
      row(2014, 1, "2015-03-01T07:10:00Z", "first"),
      row(2013, 1, "2014-03-01T07:10:00Z", "first"),
    ]);
    expect(answer.editions.map((edition) => [edition.year, edition.version, edition.publishedOn, edition.reason, edition.older.map((older) => [older.version, older.publishedOn, older.replacedOn, older.reason])])).toEqual([
      [2014, 3, "2016-01-05", "correction", [[1, "2015-03-01", "2015-05-02", "first"], [2, "2015-05-02", "2016-01-05", "hold_ended"]]],
      [2013, 1, "2014-03-01", "first", []],
    ]);
  });
});
```

```tsx
      expect(text).toContain(rule.text);

    expect(text).not.toContain(PAGE_DOWN);

      authorityAccess: null,
      terroristWithoutOrder: 1,
      referralsClosed: 0,
    },
    recipients: { low: "about 120", high: "about 340" },
  };
  const answer: PublicTransparency = {
    editions: [
      { year: 2025, version: 2, publishedOn: "2026-05-02", method: 1, reason: "hold_ended", figures: full, older: [{ version: 1, publishedOn: "2026-03-01", replacedOn: "2026-05-02", reason: "first", figures: empty }] },
      { year: 2024, version: 1, publishedOn: "2025-03-01", method: 1, reason: "first", figures: { ...empty, recipients: { low: "1 to 9" } }, older: [] },
    ],
  };

  test("each year newest first with its edition line, the reason of its newest version, its tables, its older versions and its recipients; the method once", () => {
    const markup = html(<TransparencyView answer={answer} />);
    const text = textOf(markup);
    for (const fixed of [TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.lead, TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.read, TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.tdb]) expect(text).toContain(fixed);
    expect(text.indexOf(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.edition(2025, 2, "2026-05-02", 1))).toBeLessThan(text.indexOf(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.edition(2024, 1, "2025-03-01", 1)));
    expect(text).toContain(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.reason.hold_ended);
    expect(text).toContain(`${TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.labels.ground("R1")}: about 60`);
    expect(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.labels.ground("R1")).toBe(`Rule R1: ${RULES[0]!.title}`);
    for (const line of ["The law: about 10", "Other grounds: about 10", "All restrictions: about 80", "Remove: about 70", "Other measures: 1 to 9", "Decisions that found no breach: about 140"]) expect(text).toContain(line);
    for (const line of ["Reports under korbat's rules: about 30", "Notices of illegal content (Article 16 of the Digital Services Act): about 10", "Decision kept: about 10", "No action again: about 20", "Strike: about 10"]) expect(text).toContain(line);
    // A table with no row reads its "none" sentence.
    expect(text).toContain(`${TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.tables.automated} ${TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.tableNone}`);
    // The order section's numbers, small ones too, and a figure the rows cannot give as not recorded.
    for (const line of [
      TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.orders,
      TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.orderLines.received("2", "1"),
      TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.orderLines.itemsDisabled("3"),
      TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.orderLines.minutes("10, 125"),
      TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.orderLines.outside("1"),
      TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.orderLines.annex3("force majeure 0, manifest error 0, insufficient information 1"),
      TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.orderLines.scrutiny("1", "0", "1"),
      TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.orderLines.access("not recorded"),
      TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.orderLines.terrorist("1"),
    ]) {
      expect(text).toContain(line);
    }
    // The standing sentence under every year, whether or not it has the section.
    expect(text.split(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.ordersHeld).length - 1).toBe(2);
    expect(text).toContain(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.recipients("2026-02", "about 120", "about 340"));
    expect(text).toContain(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.recipientsOff("2025-02", "1 to 9"));
    expect(text).toContain(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.versions);
    expect(text).toContain(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.versionLine(1, "2026-03-01", "2026-05-02"));
    expect(text.split(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.method(1)).length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(markup).toContain('href="/rules"');
    expect(markup).toContain('href="/explore/about"');
    // A public page points at no person: no handle, no id.
    expect(text).not.toMatch(/@|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-/);
  });

  test("a correction says so with its day; no edition yet reads [tr.none]; a route that does not answer reads [page.down] beside the fixed texts", () => {
    const corrected: PublicTransparency = { editions: [{ ...answer.editions[1]!, version: 2, reason: "correction", publishedOn: "2025-06-01", older: [] }] };
    expect(textOf(html(<TransparencyView answer={corrected} />))).toContain(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.reason.correction("2025-06-01"));
    const none = textOf(html(<TransparencyView answer={{ editions: [] }} />));
    expect(none).toContain(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.none);
    expect(none).not.toContain(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.ordersHeld);
    const down = textOf(html(<TransparencyView answer="down" />));
    expect(down).toContain(PAGE_DOWN);
    expect(down).toContain(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.lead);
    expect(down).toContain(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.tdb);
    expect(textOf(html(<TransparencyView answer="loading" />))).not.toContain(PAGE_DOWN);
  });

  test("every number of the page's words is its constant's: the due day, the floor, the rounding, the salt's hours; the recipients' last month is the one before the due day", () => {
    expect(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.read).toContain(`on or after ${TRANSPARENCY_RULES.dueDay} March of the next year`);
    expect(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.read).toContain(`korbat prints 0, "1 to ${TRANSPARENCY_RULES.floor - 1}"`);
    expect(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.read).toContain("rounded to the nearest ten");
    expect(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.read).toContain("fewer than ten");
    expect(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.none).toContain(`${TRANSPARENCY_RULES.dueDay} March`);
    expect(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.method(1)).toContain(`exists for ${RECIPIENT_RULES.saltHours} hours`);
    expect(TRANSPARENCY_PAGE.read).not.toContain("1 June");
  });

describe("the transparency page's daily value (3d Task 5, 9.3 item 6, W.2)", () => {
  const value = (c: string) => c.repeat(64);
  const head: PublicHead = {
    days: [
      { day: "2026-10-19", kind: "head", value: value("a"), witness: "rfc3161", token: "MAMCAQA=", retiredOn: null, lastDay: null },
      { day: "2026-10-18", kind: "restore", value: value("b"), witness: "none", token: null, retiredOn: null, lastDay: "2026-10-15" },
      { day: "2026-10-17", kind: "head", value: value("c"), witness: "none", token: null, retiredOn: "2026-10-18", lastDay: null },
      { day: "2026-10-15", kind: "head", value: value("d"), witness: "none", token: null, retiredOn: null, lastDay: null },
    ],
  };
  const T = TRANSPARENCY_PAGE;

  test("its section stands after the editions and before the Transparency Database: [tr.head], a row a day newest first with its value and its witness, [tr.restore], [tr.retired] and [tr.headMissing] in their places", () => {
    const text = textOf(html(<TransparencyView answer={{ editions: [] }} head={head} />));
    const at = (part: string) => {
      expect(text, part).toContain(part);
      return text.indexOf(part);
    };
    const order = [
      at(T.none),
      at(T.headHeading),
      at(T.head),
      at(T.headRow("2026-10-19", value("a"), "rfc3161")),
      at(T.restore("2026-10-18", "2026-10-15")),
      at(T.headMissingRow("2026-10-18")),
      at(`${T.headRow("2026-10-17", value("c"), "none")} ${T.retired("2026-10-18")}`),
      at(T.headMissingRow("2026-10-16")),
      at(T.headRow("2026-10-15", value("d"), "none")),
      at(T.tdbHeading),
    ];
    expect([...order].sort((a, b) => a - b)).toEqual(order);
    // A restore that found nothing that still fits says so; a day after the newest row is not shown as missing.
    expect(T.restore("2026-10-18", null)).toBe("2026-10-18: korbat restored its database from a backup. No value above still fits the restored log.");
    expect(text).not.toContain(T.headMissingRow("2026-10-20"));
    expect(text).not.toContain(T.headMissingRow("2026-10-14"));
    // A public page points at no person, and the head's place is in no row.
    expect(text).not.toMatch(/@|chainSeq|chain_seq|Place:/);
  });

  test("while a shown row has a proof: [tr.verify] as the lab ran it, with that day's value and file, and the proof to download as <day>.tsr; without one, neither", () => {
    const markup = html(<TransparencyView answer={{ editions: [] }} head={head} />);
    const text = textOf(markup);
    expect(text).toContain(T.verify(value("a"), "2026-10-19"));
    expect(T.verify(value("a"), "2026-10-19")).toBe(
      `To check a day: download its proof, get the timestamp authority's certificates from the authority itself, and run: openssl ts -verify -digest ${value("a")} -in 2026-10-19.tsr -CAfile <certificates>. It answers "Verification: OK" when that authority signed this value at the time the proof states.`,
    );
    expect(text).toContain(T.download("2026-10-19"));
    // One row has a proof, so one download: the words before the day are the same for every row.
    expect(text.split(T.download("DAY").split("DAY")[0]!).length - 1).toBe(1);
    const unwitnessed: PublicHead = { days: head.days.map((row) => ({ ...row, witness: "none", token: null })) };
    const plain = textOf(html(<TransparencyView answer={{ editions: [] }} head={unwitnessed} />));
    expect(plain).not.toContain("openssl");
    expect(plain).not.toContain(T.download("2026-10-19"));
    expect(plain).toContain(T.headRow("2026-10-19", value("a"), "none"));
  });

  test("[page.down] for this part alone; no value yet reads its sentence; while it loads, the section holds [tr.head] alone", () => {
    const down = textOf(html(<TransparencyView answer={{ editions: [] }} head="down" />));
    expect(down).toContain(T.none);
    expect(down.split(PAGE_DOWN).length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(down.indexOf(PAGE_DOWN)).toBeGreaterThan(down.indexOf(T.head));
    const both = textOf(html(<TransparencyView answer="down" head="down" />));
    expect(both.split(PAGE_DOWN).length - 1).toBe(2);
    expect(textOf(html(<TransparencyView answer={{ editions: [] }} head={{ days: [] }} />))).toContain(T.headNone);
    const loading = textOf(html(<TransparencyView answer={{ editions: [] }} head="loading" />));
    expect(loading).toContain(T.head);
    expect(loading).not.toContain(PAGE_DOWN);
    expect(loading).not.toContain(T.headNone);
  });

  test("its words are W.2's: [tr.head], [tr.headMissing], [tr.restore] and [tr.retired]", () => {
    expect(T.head).toBe(
      "Each day korbat publishes one value computed from the day and the newest entry of its staff audit log, the record of everything korbat's staff confirm with their keys. If an earlier entry were changed or removed later, the log would no longer lead to the values published since. A value shows neither how many entries the log has nor any entry, and it differs from one day to the next also when nothing was added to the log. A value on korbat's own page proves nothing against korbat's operator, who could change this page too: so the same value goes each day to a person who does not run the server, and, when the outside timestamp is on, to a timestamp authority.",
    );
    expect(T.headMissingRow("2026-10-16")).toBe("2026-10-16: no value was published");
    expect(T.restore("2026-10-18", "2026-10-15")).toBe("2026-10-18: korbat restored its database from a backup. The newest value above that still fits the restored log is of 2026-10-15.");
    expect(T.retired("2026-10-18")).toBe("retired by the restore of 2026-10-18: true when published, and fits no log now");
  });
});

describe("the smoke test looks for the pages' own lead sentences in the bundle (3d Task 4, 12.2)", () => {
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import {
  ALERT_KINDS,
  ALERT_KIND_LIST,
  CaseView,
  EDGE_CACHE,
  EDGE_PURGE_CAUSES,
  EDGE_PURGE_OUTCOMES,

  EdgePurgeView,
  OrderItemView,
  SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS,
  alertPlaceholders,
  renderAlert,
} from "../src/index";

/**
 * 3d Task 3, the edge (design, sections 7.4, 10.1, 10.3 and W.7): the two numbers of a public image's header, the
 * outbox job's numbers, the two closed lists of edge_purges, the purge line's answer on a case and on an order's item,
 * and the alert edge_purge_failed, whose every number is printed from a constant.
 */
describe("the edge's contracts (3d Task 3)", () => {
  const now = new Date("2026-10-19T12:00:00.000Z");
  const IMAGE = "1a2b3c4d-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e1";

  test("EDGE_CACHE holds the header's two numbers: a browser's minute and an edge's five minutes", () => {
    expect(EDGE_CACHE).toEqual({ browserSeconds: 60, edgeSeconds: 300 });
  });

  test("EDGE_RULES holds the job's numbers: 30 prefixes a request, a round 15 seconds after the last, 5 seconds a request, a backoff from 30 seconds to an hour, 24 hours, 30 days", () => {
    expect(EDGE_RULES).toEqual({ prefixes: 30, roundSeconds: 15, timeoutMs: 5000, backoffSeconds: 30, backoffMaxSeconds: 3600, giveUpHours: 24, keepDays: 30 });
    // One request a round: at most four a minute, under the provider's documented five.
    expect(Math.floor(60 / EDGE_RULES.roundSeconds)).toBe(4);
  });

  test("the words' two numbers come from the two constants", () => {
    expect(EDGE_WORDS).toEqual({ edgeMinutes: EDGE_CACHE.edgeSeconds / 60, giveUpHours: EDGE_RULES.giveUpHours });
    expect(EDGE_WORDS.edgeMinutes).toBe(5);
  });

  test("the closed lists of edge_purges: why an image stopped being public, and how its purge ended", () => {
    expect([...EDGE_PURGE_CAUSES]).toEqual(["state", "deleted", "released"]);
    expect([...EDGE_PURGE_OUTCOMES]).toEqual(["accepted", "failed", "off"]);
  });

  test("EdgePurgeView: an image, an outcome of the list or pending, and a time; nothing else", () => {
    for (const outcome of [...EDGE_PURGE_OUTCOMES, "pending"]) {
      expect(EdgePurgeView.safeParse({ mediaId: IMAGE, outcome, at: "2026-10-19T11:00:00.000Z" }).success, outcome).toBe(true);
    }
    expect(EdgePurgeView.safeParse({ mediaId: IMAGE, outcome: "sent", at: "2026-10-19T11:00:00.000Z" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(EdgePurgeView.safeParse({ mediaId: IMAGE, outcome: "off", at: "2026-10-19T11:00:00.000Z", token: "x" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(EdgePurgeView.safeParse({ mediaId: "not-an-id", outcome: "off", at: "2026-10-19T11:00:00.000Z" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("CaseView and OrderItemView each carry their purges", () => {
    expect(Object.keys(CaseView.shape)).toContain("purges");
    expect(Object.keys(OrderItemView.shape)).toContain("purges");
    expect(CaseView.shape.purges.safeParse([{ mediaId: IMAGE, outcome: "pending", at: "2026-10-19T11:00:00.000Z" }]).success).toBe(true);
    expect(OrderItemView.shape.purges.safeParse([{ mediaId: IMAGE, outcome: "accepted", at: "2026-10-19T11:00:00.000Z" }]).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test("edge_purge_failed: a push and a sentence to every staff account, the job's facts, as W.7 words it with every number from a constant", () => {
    // Task 3's kind follows Task 2's; Task 5's two head alerts come after it.
    expect(ALERT_KIND_LIST.indexOf("edge_purge_failed")).toBe(ALERT_KIND_LIST.indexOf("seal_released") + 1);
    expect(ALERT_KINDS.edge_purge_failed).toEqual({ priority: 3, scope: "all", legs: ["push", "mail"], mail: "sentence", facts: ["count", "oldestAt"] });
    expect(SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS).toContain("edge_purge_failed");
    expect(alertPlaceholders("edge_purge_failed").sort()).toEqual(["count", "edgeMinutes", "giveUpHours", "oldestAt"]);
    expect(renderAlert("edge_purge_failed", { count: 3, oldestAt: "2026-10-18T08:05:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "A cached copy could not be dropped",
      sentence: `3 purges at the network provider failed for ${EDGE_RULES.giveUpHours} hours, the first of 2026-10-18 08:05 UTC.`,
      todo: `The measures themselves stand. A copy may have been served for up to ${EDGE_CACHE.edgeSeconds / 60} minutes after each. The operator checks the provider's token and zone.`,
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
describe("ALERT_TEXTS (W.4): one text serves both legs, and it carries counts and times only (invariant 15)", () => {
  const now = new Date("2026-10-16T09:00:00.000Z");
  /** One set of facts for a kind: every count is `n`, every time the given instant. */
  const factsOf = (kind: AlertKind, n: number, time: string, over: Partial<Record<string, number | string | undefined>> = {}): AlertFacts => {
    const facts: Record<string, number | string> = {};
    for (const name of ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts) facts[name] = isTimeFact(name) ? time : n;
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(over)) {
      if (!ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts.includes(name)) continue;
      if (value === undefined) delete facts[name];
      else facts[name] = value;
    }
    return facts;
  };
  const DIGITS = /[0-9]/g;
  const all = (kind: AlertKind, facts: AlertFacts) => {
    const r = renderAlert(kind, facts, now);
    return [r.title, r.sentence, r.todo ?? ""].join(" | ");
  };

  test("rendered with two sets of facts, every kind's title, sentence and line differ only in their digits", () => {
    for (const kind of ALERT_KIND_LIST) {
      // The flags of order_effected and order_opened chose a variant: both sets hold the same flags.
      const flags = { urgent: 0, unknown: 0 };
      // A day (3d's head alerts) prints as its date, so the two sets name two days: they differ in digits alone.
      const first = all(kind, factsOf(kind, 3, "2026-10-16T07:05:00.000Z", { ...flags, day: "2026-10-13T00:00:00.000Z" }));
      const second = all(kind, factsOf(kind, 1234, "2026-10-16T22:49:59.999Z", { ...flags, day: "2026-10-12T00:00:00.000Z" }));
      expect(first.replace(DIGITS, ""), kind).toBe(second.replace(DIGITS, ""));
      expect(first, kind).not.toBe(second);
    }
  });

  test("no entry holds an @, a link or a placeholder that is neither a fact of its kind nor a number of ORDER_RULES, QUARANTINE_RULES or EDGE_WORDS", () => {
    for (const kind of ALERT_KIND_LIST) {
      const text = ALERT_TEXTS[kind];
      const words = [text.title, ...text.sentence.map((part) => part.text), text.todo ?? ""].join(" ");
      expect(words, kind).not.toContain("@");
      expect(words.toLowerCase(), kind).not.toContain("http");
      for (const name of alertPlaceholders(kind)) {
        expect([...ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts, ...Object.keys(ORDER_RULES), ...Object.keys(QUARANTINE_RULES), ...Object.keys(EDGE_WORDS)], `${kind}: {${name}}`).toContain(name);
      }
      // Every number a sentence of 3f prints comes from the facts or from ORDER_RULES: no digit is typed. 3c's burst
      // window is 3c's own number, which its push names as its mail does.
      if (ALERT_KINDS[kind].mail !== "own") expect(words.replace(/[{][a-zA-Z]+[}]/g, ""), kind).not.toMatch(DIGITS);
    }
  });

  test("a time prints as 14:05 UTC, with the day when it is not the day of the alert", () => {
    expect(alertTime("2026-10-16T14:05:59.000Z", now)).toBe("14:05 UTC");
    expect(alertTime("2026-10-15T23:59:00.000Z", now)).toBe("2026-10-15 23:59 UTC");
    expect(alertTime("2026-10-17T00:00:00.000Z", now)).toBe("2026-10-17 00:00 UTC");
  });

  test("the words of the kinds Task 1 sends, as W.4 has them", () => {
    const mail = renderAlert("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }, now);
    expect(mail).toEqual({
      title: "Mail at the contact point",
      sentence: "Mail at the authorities' contact point, received 08:05 UTC. If it is a removal order it is due 09:05 UTC.",
      todo: `Read it in the mail host's app, never in korbat, and with it every other new message there: further mail within ${ORDER_RULES.quietMinutes} minutes raises no alarm of its own. Then open Contact point in the staff console. What ends this message's alarms is handling it there: opening an order from it, or closing it.`,
    });
    // A restart of an order's clock has no time of receipt.
    expect(renderAlert("contact_mail", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe("A removal order's hour has started again: due 09:05 UTC.");
    expect(renderAlert("contact_mail_escalated", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "Nobody has answered: mail at the contact point",
      sentence: "Nobody has answered the mail that arrived at the authorities' contact point at 08:05 UTC. If it is a removal order it is due 09:05 UTC.",
      todo: "This went to every staff phone. Whoever reads it first acts, and tells the others.",
    });
    const due = renderAlert("order_due", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", minutesLeft: 15 }, now);
    expect(due.title).toBe("15 minutes left");
    expect(due.sentence).toBe("A removal order, or mail that may be one, is due 09:05 UTC: 15 minutes are left and it is not carried out in full.");
    expect(due.todo).toBe(
      "Give effect now, to every post the order names. Only if the order has a manifest error, or lacks what you need to find the content, send Annex III and record it: that is no way to stop this alarm. If nobody can act in time: the README, When nobody can act within the hour.",
    );
    expect(renderAlert("mailbox_unreachable", { since: "2026-10-15T23:00:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "The contact point cannot be read",
      sentence: "korbat has not been able to read the contact-point mailbox since 2026-10-15 23:00 UTC.",
      todo: `Mail that arrives there raises no alert now. Check the mailbox in the mail host's app until this is repaired; an order you find there is opened in the console under Orders, with "The message is not listed". The operator checks the password and the mail host.`,
    });
    expect(renderAlert("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "Phone alerts are down",
      sentence: "Phone alerts are down since 08:57 UTC: korbat's watcher or its push server does not answer.",
      todo: `Until it is repaired, korbat wakes nobody: the mail host's own app on the on-call phone, signed in to the contact-point mailbox and allowed to ring at night, is the only thing that does. Check now that it is. An order you find there is opened in the console under Orders, with "The message is not listed". The operator restarts the notify and ntfy services.`,
    });
    expect(renderAlert("alert_test", { at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({ title: "Daily test", sentence: "Daily test, 08:00 UTC. If you read this on your phone, alerts reach it. Nothing to do.", todo: null });
  });

  test("the pushes of 3c's and 3e's kinds name nobody", () => {
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_urgent", { count: 2, oldestAt: "2026-10-16T08:30:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({ title: "Urgent lane", sentence: "2 cases wait in the urgent lane, the oldest since 08:30 UTC.", todo: null });
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_waiting", { count: 4 }, now).sentence).toBe("4 cases or replies are waiting longer than their response time.");
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_burst", { count: 20 }, now).sentence).toBe("One staff account confirmed 20 decisions in 15 minutes. The staff mail says which.");
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_reads", { limit: 200 }, now).sentence).toBe("One staff account opened 200 different cases today. The staff mail says which.");
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_reveal", { at: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe("One staff account revealed who sent a report, at 08:59 UTC. The staff mail says which.");
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_csam_lifted", { at: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "Reported images are no longer protected",
      sentence: "A decision at 08:59 UTC ended the protection of reported images. Read the staff mail.",
      todo: null,
    });
  });

  test("the variants a fact chooses: an order given effect as urgent, with items still open; the counts of what an order misses", () => {
    expect(renderAlert("order_effected", { items: 3, at: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z", itemsOpen: 0, urgent: 0 }, now).sentence).toBe("An order was given effect at 08:59 UTC: 3 posts disabled.");
    expect(renderAlert("order_effected", { items: 2, at: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z", itemsOpen: 1, urgent: 1 }, now).sentence).toBe(
      "An order that is not verified was given effect as urgent at 08:59 UTC: 2 posts disabled. 1 items of the order are still open.",
    );
    expect(renderAlert("order_opened", { items: 2, dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:30:00.000Z", unknown: 0 }, now).sentence).toBe("An order was opened: 2 items. Due 09:30 UTC.");
    expect(renderAlert("order_opened", { items: 1, unknown: 0 }, now).sentence).toBe("An order was opened: 1 items. No deadline runs.");
    expect(renderAlert("order_opened", { items: 1, unknown: 1 }, now).sentence).toBe("An order was opened: 1 items. Its deadline is unknown: act now.");
    expect(renderAlert("order_unverified", { count: 1, textsMissing: 0, holdsOpen: 2, oldestAt: "2026-10-14T08:00:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe(
      "1 orders are given effect and not verified, or hold a post added after their check, the oldest since 2026-10-14 08:00 UTC. 2 hold a notice with no end recorded.",
    );
    expect(renderAlert("hold_ending", { count: 2, at: "2026-10-20T00:00:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe(`2 held notices are released within ${ORDER_RULES.holdWarningDays} days, the first on 2026-10-20 00:00 UTC.`);
    expect(renderAlert("report_owed", { count: 1, oldestAt: "2026-10-14T08:00:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe(
      `1 reports to the authorities have been owed for more than ${ORDER_RULES.reportAlertHours} hours, the oldest since 2026-10-14 08:00 UTC.`,
    );
  });

  test("a fact that is missing, of another kind, or a string that is no time is refused", () => {
    expect(() => renderAlert("contact_mail_escalated", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z" }, now)).toThrow(/dueAt/);
    expect(() => renderAlert("moderation_waiting", { count: 1, handle: 7 }, now)).toThrow(/handle/);
    expect(() => renderAlert("alert_test", { at: "mod_anna" }, now)).toThrow(/at/);
    expect(() => renderAlert("moderation_waiting", { count: "4" }, now)).toThrow(/count/);
  });
});
```

```ts
    const leaves: { path: string; type: string }[] = [];
    walk(PublicFacts, "facts", leaves);
    walk(PublicTransparency, "transparency", leaves);
    // 3d Task 5: the head's answer. Its `day` is the day a value was published, never a decision's.
    walk(PublicHead, "head", leaves);
    const forbidden = /(^|[.])(id|[a-z]*Id|handle|decidedAt|day|chainSeq|seq|place|hash|score|sha256|pdq|file|post|case|decision|account)$/;
    for (const leaf of leaves.filter((leaf) => leaf.path !== "head.days[].day")) expect([leaf.path, forbidden.test(leaf.path.replaceAll("[]", ""))]).toEqual([leaf.path, false]);
    expect(leaves.filter((leaf) => leaf.path.startsWith("head.")).map((leaf) => leaf.path)).toEqual([
      "head.days[].day",
      "head.days[].kind",
      "head.days[].value",
      "head.days[].witness",
      "head.days[].token",
      "head.days[].retiredOn",
      "head.days[].lastDay",
    ]);
    const outsideOrders = leaves.filter((leaf) => !leaf.path.includes(".orders"));
    const numbers = outsideOrders.filter((leaf) => leaf.type === "number").map((leaf) => leaf.path);
    expect(numbers.sort()).toEqual(
      [
        "facts.r1.threshold",
        "facts.r1.thresholdVersion",
        "transparency.editions[].method",
        "transparency.editions[].older[].version",
        "transparency.editions[].version",
        "transparency.editions[].year",
      ].sort(),
    );
    const strings = outsideOrders.filter((leaf) => leaf.type === "string").map((leaf) => leaf.path);
    expect(strings.sort()).toEqual(
      [
        "facts.match.dpia",
        "facts.match.dpiaActs",
        "facts.match.source",
        "facts.r1.digest",
        "facts.r1.dpia",
        "facts.r1.dpiaActs",
        "facts.r1.model",
        "facts.r1.publisherClaim",
        "transparency.editions[].older[].publishedOn",
        "transparency.editions[].older[].replacedOn",
        "transparency.editions[].publishedOn",
        // The head (Task 5): a publication's day, its value (a digest that shows neither the place nor a row's hash), the
        // outside token as base64, the day a restore retired it, and on a restore the last day that still fits.
        "head.days[].day",
        "head.days[].value",
        "head.days[].token",
        "head.days[].retiredOn",
        "head.days[].lastDay",
      ].sort(),
    );
    // Every other string leaf is a band, a closed list or a literal.
    expect(outsideOrders.filter((leaf) => leaf.type === "band").length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
  });
});

/** Collects the leaves of a zod schema with their paths: a band (a string under the band's pattern), an enum, a literal, a string, a number or a boolean. */
function walk(schema: z.ZodType, path: string, out: { path: string; type: string }[]): void {
  const def = (schema as unknown as { def: { type: string } & Record<string, unknown> }).def;
  switch (def.type) {
    case "object":
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(def.shape as Record<string, z.ZodType>)) walk(value, `${path}.${key}`, out);
      return;
    case "array":
      walk(def.element as z.ZodType, `${path}[]`, out);
      return;
    case "union":
      for (const option of def.options as z.ZodType[]) walk(option, path, out);
      return;
    case "optional":
    case "nullable":
      walk(def.innerType as z.ZodType, path, out);
      return;
    case "record":
      walk(def.valueType as z.ZodType, `${path}.*`, out);
      return;
    case "string": {
      const checks = (def.checks as { _zod: { def: { check: string; pattern?: RegExp } } }[] | undefined) ?? [];
      const banded = checks.some((check) => check._zod.def.pattern?.source === BAND_SOURCE);
      out.push({ path, type: banded ? "band" : "string" });
      return;
    }
    default:
      out.push({ path, type: def.type });
  }
}

/** The pattern a banded string is held to. */
const BAND_SOURCE = "^(0|1 to 9|about [1-9][0-9]*0)$";
```
